0: Ribbi chizkiyya patach, ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:2) (pinchas 233, 86 tissa 189) keshoshanna ben hachochim. man shoshanna, da keneset yisrael. (begin deit shoshana veit shoshana), ma shoshanna deihi ben hachochim it ba sumak vechivvar, uf keneset yisrael it ba din verachame. ma shoshanna it ba telesar alin, uf keneset yisrael it ba telesar mechilan derachame desacharin la mikkol sitraha. uf elohim dehacha (nasha daf kala 2, vekelach, vakemaz) (Shemot 186 1) mishata deidkar appik telesar tevin lesachara lichneset yisrael ulenatra la.

Ulevatar idkar zimna ochora. ammay idkar zimna ochora. begin leafka chamesh alin takkifin desacharin leshshoshanna. (pinchas 233 166 bakez 1), veinnun chamesh ikrun yeshuot. veinnun chamesh [chamshoyn] tarin. veal raza da ketiv (Tehillim 116:13) (teruma 169) kos yeshuot essa da kos shel beracha. kos shel beracha itzterich lemeheve al chamesh etzbean vela yattir. kegavvna deshoshanna deyatva al chamesh alin takkifin dugema dechamesh etzbean. veshoshanna da ihi (teruma kala) kos shel beracha. meelohim tinyana ad elohim telitaa chamesh tevin. mikkan ulehala or deitbere veitgeniz veitkelil bebrit hahu deal beshshoshanna (sefer acher da) veappik ba zara. veda ikre etz ose (62 2) peri asher zaro vo. vehahu zera kayyayma beot berit mammash.
Uchema dediyyukkena divrit izdera bearbein uteren ziuugin hahu (nusach acher dehahu) zara, kach izdera shema gelifa mefarash bearbein uteren atvan deovada divreshit.

Bereshit, ribbi shimon patach (Shir HaShirim 2:12) (97 1, 39 amud bet, Vayikra 4 2, lekamman 5) hannitztzanim niru vaaretz. hannitztzanim, da ovada divreshit, niru vaaretz ematay, bayyom hashshelishi, dichtiv vattotze haaretz keden niru vaaretz. et hazzamir higgia, da yom revii dehava beh zemir aritzim, meorot chaser. vekol hattor, da yom chamishi, dichtiv yishretzu hammayim vegomer lemebad toladot. nishma, da yom shishshi dichtiv naase adam. dehava atid lemikdam asiyya lishmia, dichtiv
1: Hacha naase adam, uchetiv hatam naase venishma. beartzenu, da yom shabbat deihu dugemat eretz hachayyim.

(Shehu olam habba. olam hanneshamot olam hannechamot). (nusach acher davar achar) hannitztzanim illen innun avahan dealu bammachashava vealu bealma deate veitgenizu tamman. umittamman nafku bignizu veittamiru go (nusach acher behu) nevie keshot. ityelid yosef veittamiru beh, al yosef beara kaddisha unetziv lon tamman, ucheden niru vaaretz veitgalu tamman. veematay itchazun, beshaata deitgele keshet bealma. deha beshaata dekeshet itchaze keden itgalleyan innun, uvehahi shaata et hazzamir higgia iddan lekatztzetz chayyavin mealma. ammay ishtezivu, begin dehannitztzanim niru vaaretz, veilmale deniru la ishtaarun bealma, vealma la itkayyam.

Uman mekayyem alma vegarim laavahan deitgalleyan, kal yenoke delaan beorayta, uvegin innun ravyayn dealma, alma ishteziv. lekavlehon, (Shir HaShirim 1:11) tore zahav naase lach, illen innun yenoke ravyayn ulemin dichtiv, (Shemot 25:18) veasita shenayim keruvim zahav.

Bereshit ribbi elazar patach (Yeshayahu 40:26) seu (daf 30 1) marom enechem ureu mi vara elle. seu marom enechem lean atar, leatar dechol ayynin talyan leh. uman ihu, petach enayim. vetamman tindeun dehay satim attika dekayma lashsheela. bara elle. uman ihu. mi. hahu (Shemot 140 1) deikre miktze hashshamayim leella. dechola kayyema birshuteh. veal dekayma lashsheela veihu beorach satim vela itgalya, ikre mi, deha leella let tamman sheela. vehay ketze hashshamayim ikre mi.

Veit ochora letatta veikre ma. ma ben hay lehay, ella kadmaa setimaa deikre mi kayyema (teruma 138 1, vayyakhel 211, behaalotcha 148 2, ulehallan 9 1, 16, 167 1, Shemot 157) lashsheela, chevan deshaal bar nash umefashpesh leistakkela uleminda middarga ledarga ad sof kol dargin, kevan demate tamman, ma. ma yadata, ma istakkalta, ma pishpashta, ha kola satim kidkadmita.

Veal raza dena ketiv, (Eicha 2) ma aidech ma adamme lach. kad itcheriv be makdesha nafak kala vaamar ma aidech (nusach acher uma [ma] adama lecha, behahu 45 aidech) bechol yoma veyoma, [veha] ashidat bach miyyomin kadmain dichtiv, (Devarim 30) haidoti vachem hayyom et hashshamayim veet haaretz. uma adamme lach behahu gavna mammash atarit lach beitrin kaddishin avadit lach shaltanu al alma dichtiv, (Eicha 2) hazot" hair" sheyyomru" kelilat" yfi" vegomer karena lach (tehillim 122) yerushalayim habbenuya keir shechubbera lah. (Eicha 2) ma ashve lach. kegavvna deant yatva, hachi hu kivyachol leela. kegavvna dela alin hasheta bach amma kaddisha besidderin kaddishin, hachi omena lach dela eol ana leela ad deyealun bach uchlosach letatta. veda ihu nechama dilach hoil dedarga da ashve lach bechola. vehasheta deant hacha gadol kayyam shivrech. vei tema delet lach kayyayma veasvata, mi (Shemot 237 2) yirpa lach, vadday hahu darga setimaa illaa dechola kayyeyma beh yirpa lach veyokim lach.

Mi ketze hashshamayim leela, ma vead ketze hashshamayim letatta (195 hashshamayim letatta). veda yarit yaakov deihu mavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze, min hakkatze kadmaa deihu mi, el hakkatze batraa deihu ma, begin dekaim beemtzaita. veal da mi bara elle.

Amar ribbi shimon, elazar beni pesok milach veyitgele setima deraza illaa divne alma la yadin. shatik ribbi elazar. bacha ribbi shimon vekaim riga (nusach acher sheata) chada. amar ribbi shimon, elazar may elle. i tema kochvaya umazzale, ha itchazaan tamman tadir. uvemma itberiu kema deat amer, (Tehillim 33:6) bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu. i al millin setimin la lichtov elle deha itgalleya ihu.

Ella raza da la itgalleya bar yoma chad dahavena al kef yamma, veata eliyyahu veamar li ribbi, yadat ma hu, mi bara elle. amina leh illen shemayya vechelehvn ovada dekudesha berich hu deit leh levar nash leistakkela behu ulevarcha leh dichtiv, (Tehillim 8:2) ki ere shamech maase
2: Etzbeotech vegomer Adonai adonenu ma addir shimch bechol haaretz.

Amar li ribbi milla setima hava kamme kudesha berich hu, vegale bimtivta illaa veda hu. beshata distima dechol setimin baa leitgalleya, avad beresha nekuda (lehallan 15 1, mishpatim 105 1, 9 2, Shemot 226 2, 228 1) chada, veda salik lemehve machashava. tziyyer bah kol tziyyurin. chakak bah kol gelifin.

Veaglif go botzina kaddisha setima gelifu dechad tziyyura setimaa kodesh kaddishin binyayna amika denafak miggo machashava veikre mi sheruta (nusach acher reshita) levinyana. kayyayma vela kayyayma. amik vesatim bishma. la ikre ella mi. baa leitgalyay uleitkere bishma (da) veitlabbash bilvush yekar denahir uvara elle, vesalik elle bishma. itchabberun atvavn illen beillen veishtelim bishma elohim. vead la vara elle la salik bishma elohim. veinnun dechavu beegla (nusach acher bealma). al raza dena amru (Shemot lak) elle elohecha yisrael.

Uchema deishtattaf mi beelle, hachi hu shema deishtattaf tadir. uveraza da itkayyem alma. uferach eliyyahu vela chamena leh. uminneh yedana milla (da) deokimna (vekaimna) al raza vesitra dilah. ata ribbi elazar vechulhu chavrayay veishtetachu kammeh. bachu veamru ilmale la atena lealma ella lemishma da dayyay.

Amar ribbi shimon al da shemaya vechelehon bemma itberiu, dichtiv (tehillim sham) ki ere shamecha maase etzbeotecha vegomer uchetiv, (tehillim sham) ma addir shimcha bechol haaretz asher tena" hodcha" al" hashshamayim", al hashshamayim ihu lesalka bishma. begin devara nehora linhoreh veitlabbash da veda vesalik bishma illaa. veal da bereshit bara elohim, da elohim illaa, deha ma la have hachi vela itbene.

Ella beshaata deitmashshechan atvavn illen (maayleyn) elle milleela letatta. veimma ozifat livrata mennaha, vekashsheta lah bekishuteha. veematay kashsheta lah bekishshuteha kedakka chaze. beshaata deitchazon kamah kol dechora, dichtiv el pene haadon Adonai, veda ikre adon kema deat amer, (Yehoshua 3:11) hinne aron habberit adon kol haaretz. keden nafkat Adonai veailat 10, veitkashshitat bemane dechura lekavlehon dechol dechar beyisrael.

Veatvavn ochoranin mashchan lon yisrael meela legabbe atar da (Tehillim 42:5) elle ezkera. adkarna befumay veshafichna dimay (birut nafshi begin leamshacha atvavn illen) ucheden edaddem meela ad bet elohim, lemeheve elohim kegavvna dileh. uvemay, (Tehillim 42:5) bekol rinna vetoda hamon chogeg. amar ribbi elazar shetika dili bena makdesha leela uvena makdesha letatta. uvevadday milla besela mishtoka bitren. milla besela ma deamarna veitarna beh, mishtoka bishtayim ma deshatikna deivru veivnu terin almin kechada.

Amar ribbi shimon mikkan ulehala shelimu dikra, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) hammotzi bemispar tzevaam, teren dargin innun deitzterich lemeheve reshim kol chad minayyhu. chad da deittamar ma. vechad mi. da illaa veda tattaa. da illaa rashim veamar (Shemot 168 2, vekelach 2) hammotzi bemispar tzevaam, hammotzi hahu deishtemoda velet kavvavteh. kegavvna da hammotzi lechem min haaretz. hammotzi hahu deishtemoda da darga tattaa, vechola chad. bemispar shittin ribbo innun dekayyaymin kechada, veappiku chelin lezinayyhu delet lon chushbena.

(Nusach acher kegavvna da) lechullam, ben innun shittin, ben kol chelin dilhon, beshem yikra. may beshem yikra. i tema dekara lon bishmahathon, lav hachi hu, deim ken bishmo mibbae leh. ella bezimna dedarga da la salik bishma (leella) veikre mi, la olid vela appik temirin lezineh af al gav dechulhu havu temirin beh. kevan devara elle veistallak bishmeh veikre elohim, keden bechela dishma da appik lon bishlimu, veda hu beshem yikra, behahu shem dileh kera veappik kol zina vezina leitkayyma bishlimuteh. kegavvna da (Shemot 31:2) ree karati veshem. adkarna shemi leitkeyayma betzalel al kiyyum ashlamuteh.
Merov onim, (Yeshayahu 40:26) may merov onim, da (pikkude 231 2) rish dargin, disliku beh kol reutin veistallaku beh
3: Veorach satim. veammitz koach da raza dealma illaa deistallak beshem elohim kidkaamran. ish lo nedar meinnun shittin ribbo deafik bechela dishma. uvegin deish lo nedar, bechol atar demitu yisrael veitanashu bechovayyho itmenun vela aadar meinnun (157 1, Shemot 22 1) shittin ribbo afilu chad. begin lemeheve kola diukena chada. kema deish la nedar leela, uf hachi la nedar letatta.

Bereshit, rav hamenuna sava amar, ashkechan atvavn behippucha. bet bekadmita ulevatar. 2 bekadmita hayeynu bereshit. bara levatar. alef bekadmita ulevatar. alef bekadmita hayeynu elohim. et levatar. ella kad baa kudesha berich hu lemebad alma, kol atvavn havu setimin, uteren alfin shenin ad dela bera alma hava mistakkel kudesha berich hu veishtasha behu.

Kad bea lemivre alma, atu (mikketz 204 1, vayyiggash 205 2) kol atvavn kammeh missofa areshayyhu. shariat at <big>400</big> lemeal berisha, amra, ribbon almin nicha kammach lemivre bi alma, deana chotma degushepanka dilach emet, veat itkeriat emet, yaot lemalka (emet) lemishre beot emet ulemivre bi alma. amar lah kudesha berich hu, yaot ant vezakkaa ant, ella let ant keday lemivre bach alma, hoil veant zammina lemeheve rashim al mitzchin deguverin mehemnin dekiyyeymu orayta melf vead 416, uvirshimu dilach yemutun. veod deant chotama demavet. hoil veant kach, let ant keday lemivre bach alma. miyyad nafkat.

Alat at <big>300</big> kammeh, amra kammeh, ribbon almin, nicha kammach lemivre bi alma, devi itkere shemach shadday, veyaot lemivre alma bishma kaddisha. amar lah, yaot ant, vetav ant ukeshot ant, aval hoil veatvavn deziyyufa natlin lach lemeheve immehon, la vaena lemivre bach alma, divgin dela yitkayyaym shikra, ella i yitlun lach <big>300</big>

Mikkan man devae lememar shikra (vayyakhel 215 2) yittol yesoda dikshot bekadmita ulevatar yokim leh shikra, deha at at keshot ihu, at keshot daavahatan deityaychadu va. <big>300</big> (pikkude 264 1, teruma 148 2) atvavn deitchaziu al sitra visha innun uvegin leitkayyayma natle at <big>300</big> begavvavyyhu vahave kesher. kevan dechamat hachi nafkat mikkammeh.

Alat at <big>90</big> amra kammeh, ribbon alma nicha kammach lemivre bi alma deana (sefer acher deve) bi chatimin tzaddikim, veant deitkeriat tzaddik, bi rashim dichtiv, (Tehillim 11:7) ki tzaddik Adonai tzedakot ahev, uvi yaot lemivre alma. amar lah tzaddi, tzaddik ant, vetzaddik ant itkeriat, aval ant tzarich lemehve temira, let ant tzarich leitgalleya kol kach begin dela lemehav pitchon pe lealma. may tama <big>50</big> ihi, atya 10 dishma divrit kaddisha verachiv alah (veitachad) (veitachid) bahadah. veraza da kad bera kudesha berich hu leadam harishon du partzufin berao. uvegin kach anpoy deyud mehaddar laachora kegavvna da [chaser tziyyur] vela ithadderu anippin beanpin kegavvna da [chaser tziyyur], istakkal leela kegavvna da [chaser tziyyur], istakkalat letatta kegavvna da [chaser tziyyur], amar lah kudesha berich hu (tuv) (406), deana zammin lenasra lach ulemebad lach appin beappin aval beatra ochora tistallak. nafkat mikkameh veazalat.

Alat at <big>80</big> amra kammeh, ribbon almin nicha kammach lemivre bi alma deha purekana deant zammin lemebad bealma bi reshim, veda hu pedut. uvi yaot lemivre alma. amar lah yaot ant, aval bach itreshim pesha bitmiru, kegavvna dechivya demache veail resheh ben gufeh, hachi man dechav kafif resheh veappik yedoy. vechen <big>70</big> avon, af al gav deamra deit be anava, amar lah kudesha berich hu, la ivre vach alma. nafkat mikkammeh.
4: Almin, nicha kammach lemivre bi alma, deit bi semicha lanoflin dichtiv, (Tehillim 145:14) somech Adonai lechol hannoflim. amar lah, al da ant tzarich leatrach vela tazuz minneh, i at nafik meatrach ma tehe alayyhu (6 amud alef) deinnun nefilin hoil veinnun semichin alach. miyyad nafkat mikkammeh.

Alat at <big>50</big> amra kammeh, ribbon alma, nicha kammach lemivre bi alma, devi ketiv nora tehillot utehilla detzaddikim nava tehilla. amar lah, nun tuv leatrach, deha veginach tavat samech leatrah vehave samich alah. miyyad tavat leatrah venafkat mikkammeh.

Alat at <big>40</big> amra kammeh ribbon alma, nicha kammach lemivre bi alma, devi itkeriat melech. amar lah hachi hu vadday, aval la ivre bach alma begin dealma itzterich lemelech tuv leatrach, ant v-<big>30</big> v-<big>20</big> deha la yaot lealma lemekam bela melech.

Behahi shaata nachata <big>20</big> min kodamohi at meal kurese yekareh izdazeat veamra kammeh, ribbon alma, nicha kammach lemivre bi alma deana kevodach. vechad nachatat <big>20</big> meal kurese yekareh izdazeu matan (8 2) elef almin veizdaza kurseyay vechulhu almin izdazau leminpal. amar lah kudesha berich hu chaf chaf, ma at avid hacha, dela ivre bach alma. tuv leatrach deha bach kelaya (Yeshayahu 10:23) kala venechoratza ishtema, tuv lecharseyaych vehave tamman. behahi shaata nafkat mikkammeh vetavat leduchetah.

Alat at <big>10</big> amra kammeh, ribbon alma, nicha kammach lemivre bi alma deana sheruta dishma kaddisha veyaot lach lemivre bi alma. amar lah, day lach deant chakik bi, veant rashim bi, vechol reuta dili bach salik, let ant yaot leitakkara min shemi.

Alat at <big>9</big> (teruma 152 amud alef) amra kammeh ribbon alma nicha kammach lemivre bi alma deant bi itkeriat tov veyashar. amar lah la ivre bach alma deha tuvach satim begavvavch, vetzafun begavvavch, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 31:20) ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha hoil veganiz begavvavch let beh chulaka lealma da deana bae lemivre, ella bealma (Shemot 152 1) deate. vetu deal detuvach ganiz begavvavch yitbeun tare dehechala. hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha 2:9) tavu vaaretz sheareha. vetu d<big>8</big> lekivlach vechad titchabberun kechada ha <big>17</big>, veal da atvavn illen la reshimin beshivtin kaddishin. miyyad nafkat mikkammeh.

Alat <big>7</big> at amra kammeh ribbon alma, nicha kammach lemivre bi alma, devi natrin benaych shabbat dichtiv, (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. amar lah la ivre bach alma deant it bach kerava vecharba deshinna veromacha dikrava kegavvna denun. miyyad nafkat mikkammeh.

Alat at <big>6</big> amra kammeh ribbon alma, nicha kammach lemivre bi alma, deana at mishshemach. amar lah vav ant v day lechon deattun atvavn dishmi deattun beraza dishmi vechakikin ugelifin bishmi vela ivre bachu alma.

Alat at <big>4</big> veat <big>3</big> amru uf hachi, amar uf lon day lechon lemehve da im da deha miskenin la yitbattelun min alma utzerichin ligmol immehon tivu. dalet ihu miskena, giml gemol lah tivu, la titparshun da min da veday lechon lemezan da leden.
Alat at <big>2</big> amra leh, ribbon alma, nicha kammach lemivre bi alma, devi mevarchan lach leela vetatta. amar lah kudesha berich hu, ha vadday bach ivre alma veat tehe sheruta lemivre alma.

Kayyma at <big>1</big> la alat. amar lah kudesha berich hu alef alef lamma let ant alat kammay kishar kol atvavn. amra kammeh ribbon alma begin dachamena dechol atvavn nafku min kammach bela toalta ma ana aavid tamman. vetu deha
5: Yehivta leat bet nevazbeza ravreva da, vela yaot lemalka illaa leaavara nevazbeza deyahav leavdo ulemehav leachara. amar lah kudesha berich hu alef alef af al gav deat vet ba ivre alma, at tehe resh lechol atvavn, let bi yichuda ella bach. bach yishrun kol chushebanin vechol ovade dealma, vechol yichuda la have ella beat alef.

Veavad kudesha berich hu atvavn illain ravrevan, veatvavn tattain zeirin. uvegin kach bet bet bereshit bara. alef alef elohim et. atvavn milleela veatvavn mittatta, vechulhu kechada havu mealma illaa umealma tattaa.

Bereshit ribbi yuday amar may bereshit, bechachma, da chachma, dealma kayyma alah, leala go razin setimin illain. (Bereshit 40 amud bet) vehacha iglifu shit sitrin ravrevin illain deminhon nafik kola, deminhon itavidu shit mekorin venachalin, leala go yamma rabba. vehayenu bara shit mehacha itberiu. man bara lon, hahu dela idkar hahu satim dela yedia.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havu azle bearcha, kad matu lechad be chakal, amar leh ribbi chiyyay leribbi yose ha deamritu bara shit vadday hachi hu, begin deshit yomin illain gabbe orayyta vela yattir. ochoranin setimin innun.

Aval chamenan go sitre bereshit deamar hachi. gelife (galeypev) aglif hahu setimaa kaddisha go meoy dechad temiru denakit (danekayd) binkuda denaitz. hahu gelife (galeypev) aglif vetamir beh keman deganiz kolla techot maftecha chada, vehahu maftecha ganiz kolla behechala chada, veaf al gav dechola ganiz behahu hechala, ikkera dechola behahu maftecha have. hahu maftecha sagir ufatach.

Behahu hechala it beh genizin setimin saggiin illen al illen. behahu hechala it tarin ovad setimu veinnun chamshin. iglifu learba sitrin vehavu arbein (70 vatesha). chad tara let leh sitra, la yedia i hu leela, i hu letatta (70 ihu leella ihi letatta). uvegin kach hahu tara satim.

Go innun tarin it manula chada, vechad atar dakkik leala hahu maftecha beh, vela itreshim ella birshimu demaftecha, la yadin beh ella hahu maftecha (70 defitcha) bilchodoy. veal raza dena bereshit bara elohim. bereshit da maftecha dechola satim beh, vehu sagir ufatach, veshit tarin kelilan beh. behahu maftecha desagir ufatach. kad sagir innun tarin vechalil lon begavveh (nusach acher vechala begavveh) keden vadday ketiv bereshit milla galya bichlal milla setimaa. uvechol atar bara milla setimaa ihu. sagir vela fatach.

Amar ribbi yose vadday hachi hu, veshamana lebutzina kaddisha deamar hachi, demilla setimaa ihu bara sagir vela fatach. uveod dehava sagir bemilla devara, alma la have vela itkeyyaym, vehava chafe al kolla tohu, vechad shalta hay tohu, alma la hava, vela itkeyyaym.

Ematay hahu maftecha patach tarin veizdamman leshimmusha ulemebad toldin kad ata avraham dichtiv elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram vetaninan beavraham. uma dehava kolla satim bemillat bara, ithadderu atvavn leshimmusha, venafak ammuda deavad toldin, ever yesoda kaddisha dealma kayyma aleh.

Kad hay ever itreshim bemillat bara keden reshim setimaa ilaa (nusach acher kaddisha legallaa) reshimu ochora lishmeh velikareh. veda ihu mi. uvara elle vegam ken shema kaddisha deitbarcha deihu ma itreshim. veappik min bara ever. vehu reshim beelle missitra da veever missitra da. setimaa kaddisha. elle kayyayma. ever kayyayma. kad ishtelim da ishtelim da. galif lehay ever galif lehay elle.
Itaru atvavn leashlama lehay sitra ulehay sitra, keden appik mem. natil chad lehay sitra vechad lehay sitra, ishtelim shema kaddisha veitavid elohim gam ken shema
6: Deavraham. kad ishtelim da ishtelim da. veyesh omrim denatal kudesha berich hu mi veshade beelle veitavid elohim. venatal kudesha berich hu ma veshade beever veitavid avraham. (umillat 50 romez lachamishshim shaare bina veit bah yod ot kadmaa dishma kaddisha. umillat 45 romez lamenaynaa dishma kaddisha, veit beh ot tinyayna dishma kaddisha Adonai. kema deat amar, 0 ashre haam shekkacha lo vegomer 1 tola eretz al beli 45. ucheden itkayymu teren almin. beYod alma deate, 14 alma da. kelomar 52 bara olam habba 53 bara olam hazze. vedin hu 247 ella vetatta). ucheden avid toldot venafak shema shelim ma dela hava kodam dena, hada hu dichtiv elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, kulhu havu talyayn ad deitbere shemeh deavraham. kevan deishtelim shema da deavraham, shema kaddisha ishtelim. hada hu dichtiv beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim.

Ishtattach ribbi chiyyay beara uneshak leafra, uvecha veamar afra afra kamma at keshe kedal, kamma at bachatzifu. dechol machamadde ena yitbelun bach, kol ammude nehorin dealma techul veteduk. kamma at chatzifa, botzina kaddisha dehava nahir alma, shallita ravreva memanna dizchuteh mekayyem alma itbele bach. ribbi shimon nehiru devutzina nehiru dealmin ant bale beafra veant kayyaym venaheg alma. ishtomem riga chada, veamar afra afra la titgae dela yitmasserun bach ammudin dealma deha ribbi shimon la itbele bach.

Kam ribbi chiyyay vehava bache. azal veribbi yose immeh. mehahu yoma itanne arbein yomin lemechome leribbi shimon. amru leh let ant rashshay lemecheme leh. becha veitanni arbein yomin acharinin. achaziu leh bechezvav leribbi shimon veribbi elazar bereh, dehavu laan bemilla da deamar ribbi yose, vehavu kamma alfin tzayytin lemilluleh.

Adhachi chama kamma gadfin ravrevin illain useliku alayyhu ribbi shimon veribbi elazar bereh useliku limtivta dirkia, vechol illen gadfin havu mechakkan lehu. chama demithadderan umitchaddeshan bezivon unehiru yattir minhora deziva deshimsha.

Patach ribbi shimon veamar yiyiul ribbi chiyyay velechome bekma dezammin kudesha berich hu lechadta anpe tzaddikayyay lezimna deate. zakkaa ihu man deal hacha bela chissufa, vezakkaa man dekaim behahu alma keammuda takkif bechola. vechama dehava al, vehava kam ribbi elazar ushear ammudin deyatvin tamman. vehu hava kesif veashmit garmeh veal veyativ leragloy deribbi shimon.

Kala nafak veamar maich enach. la tizkof reshach, vela tistakkal. maich enoy vechama nehora dehava nahir lemerachok. kala ahadar kemilkaddemin veamar illain temirin setimin pekiche ena innun dimshattin bechol alma istekalu vechamu. tattain (nusach acher tenain) demichin setimin bechorechon itaru.

Man minchon di chashocha mehappechan linhora vetaamin merira lemitka ad la yeton hacha. man minnechon dimchakkan bechol yoma linhora denahir beshaata demalka pakid (vayyakhel 196 amud alef) leayyalta veityaykar veitkere malka mikkol malchin dealma. man dela metzappe da bechol yoma behahu alma, let leh chulaka hacha.
Addehachi chama kamma min chavrayay sacharaneh kol innun ammudin dekayyaymin. vechama disliku lon limtivta dirkia. illen salkin veillen nachatin, veela dechulehu chama mare degadfe dehava ate
Vehu ome omaa deshama meachore pargoda demalka mafkad bechol yoma udechir leayyalta di shechivat leafra, uveat beitin behahu shaata bitlat (Shemot 42) mea vetishin rekiin, vechulhu merattetin vezain
7: Kammeh. veorid dimin al da, venafle innun dimin retichin keesha lego yamma rabba, umeinnun dimin kaim hahu memanna deyamma veitkeyyaym vekadish shemeh demalka kaddisha vekabbil aleh lemivla kol memoy divreshit veyichnosh lehu legavveh beshata deyitkanshun kol ammayya al amma kaddisha, vinagvon mayya, veyaavrun bingivu.

Adhachi shama kala deamar pannun atar, pannun atar deha malka meshicha ate limtivta deribbi shimon begin dechol tzaddikayyay detamman reshe metivta veinnun metivte detamman reshimin innun. vechol innun chavrin di bechol metivta salke (sallekin) mimmetivta dehacha limtivta dirkia. umashiach ate bechol innun metivte vechatim orayyta mippumayyhu derabbanan. uvehahi shaata ate mashiach mitatter min (nusach acher reshe) reche metivte beitrin illain.

Behahu shaata kamu kol innun chavrayay vekam ribbi shimon vehava salik nehoreh ad rum rakia, amar leh ribbi zakkaa ant deorayytach salka bitlat mea veshivin nehorin, vechol nehora unehora itparshat leshit mea utelesar taamin salkin veistachyayn benahare afarsemona dachya. vekudesha berich hu ihu chatim orayyta mimmetivtach umimtivta dechizkiyya melech yehuda umiggo metivta deachiyya hashshiloni.

Veana la atena lemichtam mimtivtach, ela) mare degadfin ate hacha, deha yedana dela yeul go metivte achritti ella bimtivtach. behahi shaata sach leh ribbi shimon hahu omaa deome mare degaddefin. keden izdaza mashiach vearim kaleh veizdazeu rekiin veizdaza yamma rabba veizdaza livyatan vechashiv alma leithappecha. adhachi chama leribbi chiyyay leragloy deribbi shimon. amar man yahiv hacha bar nash lavish madda dehahu alma. amar (leh) ribbi shimon da ihu ribbi chiyyay nehiru devutzina deorayyta. amar leh yitkannesh hu uvenoy velehevon mimtivta dilach. amar ribbi shimon zimna yityeyhiv leh.

Yahavu leh zimna venafak mittamman mizdaza vezalgan enoy dimin. izdaza ribbi chiyyay uvecha veamar zakkaa chulakhon detzaddikayay behahu alma, vezakkaa chulakeh devar yochay dezacha lechach. aleh ketiv, (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle.

Bereshit ribbi shimon patach (Yeshayahu 51:16) vaasim devaray beficha. kamma it leh levar nash leishtaddela beorayyta yemama velelya, begin dekudesha berich hu tzayyit lekalhon deinnun demitasseke beorayyta, uvechol milla deitchaddash beorayyta al yeda dehahu deishtaddal beorayta, avid rekia chada.

Tenan behahi shaata demilla deorayyta itchaddeshat mippumeh devar nash, hahi milla salka veitattedat kammeh dekudesha berich hu. vekudesha berich hu natil lehahi milla venashik lah veattar lah beshivin itrin gelifin umechakkekan. umilla dechachmeta deitchaddesha, salka veyatva al resha detzaddik chay almin. vetasa mittamman veshata beshivin elef almin uselikat legabbe attik yomin. vechol millin deattik yomin millin dechachmeta innun berazin setimin illain.

Vehahi milla setima dechachmeta deitchaddeshat hacha kad salka itchabberat beinnun millin (derazin) deattik yomin vesalka venachta bahadayyhu vealat betamnesar almin genizin (Yeshayahu 64:3) deayin la raata elohim zulatecha. nafke mittamman veshatan veatyayn melean ushelemin veitattadu kamme attik yomin. behahi shaata arach attik yomin behay milla venicha kammeh mikkola. natil lehahi milla veatar lah (Shemot 14) bitlat mea veshivin elef itrin. hahi milla tasat vesalka venachta veitavida rekia chada.

Vechen kol milla umilla dechachmeta (sefer acher ateabedayn) (sefer acher rekiin) kayyaymin bekiyyuma shelim kamme attik yomin. vehu kare lon shamayim chadashim, shamayim mechudashim, setimin derazin dechachmeta illaa. vechol innun shear millin deorayyta demitchaddeshin kayyaymin kamme
8: Kudesha berich hu vesalkin veitavidu artzot hachayyim. venachtin umitatterin legabbe eretz chad, veitchaddash veitavid kola eretz chadasha mehahi milla deitchaddash beorayyta.

Veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 66:22) ki kaasher hashshamayim hachadashim vehaaretz hachadasha asher ani ose omdim lefanay vegomer. asiti la ketiv ella ose, deavid tadir meinnun chiddushin verazin deorayyta. veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 51:16) vaasim devaray beficha uvetzel yadi kissiticha lintoa shamayim velisod aretz. hashshamayim la ketiv ella shamayim.

Amar ribbi elazar mahu uvetzel yadi kissiticha. amar leh beshaata deitmasar orayyta lemoshe, atu kamma ribbo demalache illain leokda leh beshalhova defumehon, ad dechafa aleh kudesha berich hu. vehasheta dehay milla salka veitatterat vekayyma kamme kudesha berich hu, ihu chafe al hahi milla vechasse al hahu bar nash dela yishtemoda legabbayyhu ella kudesha berich hu. vela yekanneun legabbeh ad deitavid mehahi milla shamayim chadashim veeretz chadasha hada hu dichtiv uvetzel yadi kissiticha lintoa shamayim velisod aretz. mikkan dechol milla desatim meena salka letoalta illaa hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 51:16) uvetzel yadi kissiticha. veammay itchafe veitkasse meena, begin letoalta illaa. hada hu dichtiv lintoa shamayim velisod aretz kema deittemar.

Velemor letziyyon ammi atta. velemor leinnun tarin umillin dimtzuyaynin illen al illen ammi atta. al tikre (bateykevan 18 daf la 2) ammi atta, ella immi atta lemehve shuttafa immi, ma ana bemillula dili avadit shamayim vaaretz kema deat amer, (Tehillim 33:6) bidvar Adonai shamayim naasiu, uf hachi at. zakkain innun demishtaddele beorayyta. vei tema demilla dechol bar nash dela yada avid da.

Ta chaze, hahu delav archeh (yitro 87 1) berazin deorayyta vechiddesh millin dela yeda al bureyehon kedka yeut, hahi milla salka venafik legabbe hahi mila (Mishlei 16:28) ish tahpuchot leshon shaker, miggo nukeva dithoma rabba vedalig chamesh mea parse lekabbela lehahi milla venatil lah veazil behahi milla lego nukeveh veavid bah rekia deshav deikre tohu.

Vetas behahu rekia hahu ish tahpuchot shitta alfe parse bezimna chada. kevan dehay rekia deshav kaim nafkat miyyad (pikkude 275) eshet zenunim veatkif behahu rekia deshav (nusach acher hi) (nusach acher veish tahpuchot) veishtattefat beh umittamman nafkat vekatlat kamma alafin verivvavn, begin dechad kayymat behahu rekia it lah reshu vichalta lemeheve tas kol alma beriga chada.

Veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu Adonai:18) hoy moshche heavon bechavle hashsheva. heavon da dechura. vechaavot haagala chattaa. man chattaa, da nukeva deikre chattaa. ihu mashich hahu deikre avon beinnun chavle hashshav. ulevatar kaavot haagala chattaa, lehahi nukeva deikre chattaa, detamman ittakfat lemehve tas lekatla bene nasha. veal da (Mishlei 7:26) ki rabbim chalalim hippila, man hippila, da hahi chattaa dekatlit bene nesha. man garim da, talmid chacham dela mate lehoraa umore, rachamana lishshezvan.

Amar ribbi shimon lechavraya bematuta minnayycho dela tafkun mippumayychu milla deorayyta dela (yitro 87 1) yedatun vela shematun meilana ravreva kedka yeut, begin dela tehvon garmin lehahu chattaa lekatla uchlosin debar nash lemaggana. patchu kulhon veamru rachamana lishshezvan, rachamana lishshezvan.

Ta chaze, beorayyta bara kudesha berich hu alma, veha ukemuha dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon vaehye shaashuim yom yom veihu istakkal bah zimna uteren utelata vearba zimnin, ulevatar amar lon, ulevatar avid bah avidta. leulefa livne nasha dela yiyiton lemite bah. kema deat amer, (Iyov 28:27-28) az raah vaysapperah hchinah vegam chakarah vayyomer laadam.

Velokovel arba zimnin innun dichtiv, az raah, vaysapperah, hchinah, vegam chakarah, bara kudesha berich hu ma devara. vead la appik avidteh, ail arba tevin bekadmita dichtiv bereshit bara elohim et, ha arba. ulevatar hashshamayim. innun lokovel arba zimnin deistakkal kudesha berich hu beorayta ad la yappik avidteh leumenuteh.
Ribbi elazar hava azil lemechome leribbi yose beribbi shimon ben lakonya chamoy
9: Veribbi abba bahadeh, vehava tain chad gavra abbatrayyhu. amar ribbi abba niftach pitchin deorayyta deha shaata veiddana hu leittakkana vearchan.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar (Vayikra 19:30) et shabbetotay tishmoru. ta chaze, beshit yomin bera kudesha berich hu alma. vechol yoma veyoma gale avidteh veyahav cheleh behahu yoma. ematay gale avidteh veyahav cheleh. beyoma reviaa. begin deinnun telat yomin kadmain kulehu havu setimin vela itgalu, kevan deata yoma reviaa appik avidta vechela dechulehu.
Deha esha umaya verucha af al gav deinnun telat yesodin illain, kulhu talyayn, vela itgeli avidta dilhon, ad deara gale lon, keden ityeda umenuta dechol chad minnayyhu.

Vei tema ha beyoma telitaa hava dichtiv tadshe haaretz deshe uchetiv vattotze haaretz (deshe). ella hay af al gav dichtiv beyoma telitaa, reviaa hava veitkelil beyoma telitaa lemeheve chad bela piruda. ulevatar yoma reviaa itgeli avidteh leappaka omana leumanuteh dechol chad vechad. begin deyoma reviaa ihu ragla reviaa dekurseyay illaa.

Vechol avidtayyhu dechulhu ben yomin kadmain uven yomin batrain havu talyayn beyoma deshabbatta hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii, da shabbat, veda hu ragla reviaa dekurseyay.
Vei tema i hachi, mahu et shabbetotay tishmoru teren. ella shabbat (teruma 135 2) demaale shabbeta veshabbatta deyoma mammash let lon piruda.

Amar (lehu) hahu tayya dehava tain batrayyhu, umahu umikdashi tirau. amar leh da kiddusha deshabbat. amar leh umahu kiddusha deshabbat. amar leh da kiddusha deitmashshecha (aleh) milleela. amar leh i hachi avedat leshabbat delav ihu kodesh, ella kiddusha desharya aloy milleela. amar ribbi abba vehachi hu (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat ong likdosh Adonai mechubbad, idkar shabbat lechud ukedosh Adonai lechud. amar leh i hachi man kedosh Adonai. amar leh kedusha denachata milleela vesharya aleh. amar leh i kedusha deitmashshecha milleela ikre mechubbad itchazze deshabbat lav ihu mechubbad uchetiv vechibbadto. amar ribbi elazar leribbi abba anach lehay gavra demilla (chadta) dechachmeta it beh deanan la yedana vah. amru leh ema ant.

Patach veamar, (Vayikra 19) et shabbetotay. et leasgaa techum shabbat deihu teren alfin ammin lechol sitra (vayyakhel 207 1). uvegin kach asge et. shabbetotay (nusach acher da) shabbat illaa veshabbat tattaa deinnun teren kelilan kechada usetimin kechada.

Ishtaar shabbat (yitro 92 1 242) ochora dela idkar vehava bechissufa. amra kammeh mare dealma miyyoma deavdat li shabbat itkarena veyoma lav ihu bela lelya. amar lah beratti shabbat ant veshabbat karena lach, aval ha ana meatter lach beitra illaa yattir. aavar keroza veamar mikdashi tirau. veda shabbat demaale shabbatta deihi yira, vesharya vah yira. uman ihu. dekudesha berich hu achlil veamar ani Adonai. veana shemana meabba deamar hachi. vedayyek et leasgaa techum shabbat. shabbetotay da iggula (229 1, tetzavve 180 1, vayyakhel 205 1) veribbua dilgo, veinnun teren. ulekovel innun teren it tere kedushate deit lanu leadkara, chad vaychullu, vechad kadosh. vaychullu it beh telatin vechamesh tevin. uvikdusha (vabekaydaveshaa) deanan mekaddeshin telatin vechamesh tevin. vesalik kolla leshivin shemahan dekudesha berich hu uchenset yisrael itattar behu.

Uvegin deiggula veribbua da innun shabbetotay, kelilan tarvayyhu beshamor dichtiv tishmoru. deha shabbat illaa hacha la itkelil beshamor ella bezachor, deha malka illaa bezachor istayyaym. veal da ikre malka dishlama dileh, ushelama dileh zachor ihu. veal da let machloket leela.
Begin ditren shelomot letatta chad yaakov vechad yosef. uvegin kach ketiv tere zimne (Yeshayahu 57:19) shalom shalom larachok velakkarov. larachok da yaakov,
10: Velakkarov da yosef. larachok kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 31:3) merachok Adonai nira li (Shemot 2:4) vattetatztzav achoto merachok. velakkarov kema deat amer, (Devarim 32:17) chadashim mikkarov bau. merachok da nekuda illaa dekayyma behechaleh.

Veal da ketiv tishmoru itkelil beshamor. (vaetchannan 260) umikdashi tirau da nekuda dekayyma beemtzaita deit ledachala minnah yattir mikkolla deansheh mita. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Shemot 31:14) mechallaleha mot yumat. man mechallaleha. man deal lego chalal deiggula veribbua leatar dehahu dinkuda (nekuda) sharya (beh) ufagim beh mot yumat. veal da ketiv tirau. vehahi nekuda ikre ani, vealah sharya hahu desatim illaa dela itgalleya vehayeynu Adonai vecholla chad. nachatu ribbi elazar veribbi abba uneshakuhu. amru uma kol chachmeta da it techot yedach veat tain abbatrin. amru leh man ant. amar lon la tishalun man ana, ella ana veattun nezel venitassek beorayyta vechol chad yiyima millin dechachmeta leanhara orcha.

Amru leh man yahav lach lemezal hacha ulemeheve (ulemeheve) taun (taen) bechamre, amar lon yod avad kerava bitren atvavn bechaf vesamach leitkashra bahadday (nusach acher kachada). kaf la baa leistallaka uleitkashshara batar (nusach acher baatar) dela yachla lemeheve riga chada ella beh. samech la vaa leistallaka begin lesaada leinnun denaflin deha beli samech la yachlin lemeheve.

Yod ata legabbay yechidaa nashik li vegappif li bacha immi veamar li beri ma aavid lach, aval ha ana istallak veana itmele mikkamma tavin veatvavn temirin illain yakkirin, batar ken ayte legabbach veana eheve seid lach veetten lach achsanta ditren atvavn illain yattir meillen deistallaku deinnun 310 yod illaa veshin illaa lemehve lach otzrin malyay mikkol. uvegin kach beri zil veheve tein chamre. veal da ana azil bechach.

Chadu ribbi elazar veribbi abba uvachu veamru zil rechiv veanan natin abbatrach. amar lon vela amarit lechon depikuda demalka ihu ad deyete hahu detaan (detaen) chamre. amru leh ha shemach la amart lan, atar bet motavach may hu. amar lon atar bet motvi ihu tav veayyla legabbay, veihu (resh tikun 21 daf 52 amud alef uvereshit 36 amud bet) migdal chad defarach baavira rav veyakkira. veinnun dedayyrin beh behay migdela, kudesha berich hu vechad miskena. veda hu atar bet motvi vegalena (nusach acher vaalaynaa) mittamman veana tain chamre. ashgachu ribbi abba veribbi elazar beh veatim lon milloy dehavu metikin kemanna veduvesha. amru leh shema deavuch i tema nanshik afra deraglach. amar lon veammay, lav orach dili bechach leitgaa beorayyta.

Aval abba dili hava diyyureh beyamma rabba veihu hava chad nuna dehava (tikkunim 52, uvereshit lo amud bet) aschar yamma rabba missitra da lesitra da, vehava rav veyakkira veattik yomin, ad dehava bala kol shear nunin deyamma, ulevatar appik lon chayin vekayyamin malyayn mikkol tavin dealma. veshaat yamma beriga chada betokpeh, veappik li kegira bida digvar takif, vetamir li behahu atar deamarit lechu. vehu tav leatreh veigniz behahu yamma.

Ashgach ribbi elazar bemilloy. amar leh ant hu bereh devutzina kaddisha, ant hu bereh derav hamenuna sava, ant hu bereh dinhiru deorayyta veant tain abbatran. bachu kechada uneshakuhu veazlu. amru leh i nicha kamme marana leoda lan shemeh.

Patach veamar (Shmuel 2 23:20) uvenayahu ben yehoyada. hay kera okmuah veshappir ihu. aval hay kera leachazaa razin illain deorayyta hu deata. uvenayahu ben yehoyada, al raza dechachmeta ka ata milla setima ihu, ushema garim. ben ish chay (vayyetze 164 1) da tzaddik chay almin. rav pealim, mare dechol ovadin vechol chelin illain, begin dechullehu nafkin minneh. Adonai tzevaot ihu, ot hu bechol chayaylin dideh reshim hu verav mikkola.
Rav pealim ihu mekavtziel hay ilana rav veyakkira, rav mikkolla. mean atar nafak, mean darga ata, ahadar kera veamar mekavtziel darga illaa setimaa
11: Deayin la raata vegomer darga dechola beh, uchenesh begavveh miggo nehora illaa, uminneh nafik kolla.
Veihu hechala kaddisha setima dechol dargin kenishin usetimin begavveh. uvegufa dehay hechala (ilana) kayyaymin, kol almin vechol chayyalin kaddishin minneh itzanu vekayyme al kiyyumehon.

Hu hikka et shene ariel moav. teren mikdeshin havu kayyaymin begineh veitzenu minneh mikdash rishon umikdash sheni, kevan deihu istallak, negidu dehava negid milleela itmena, kivyachol hu hikka lon vechariv lon veshatze lon. vekurseyay kaddisha naflat hada hu dichtiv (Yechezkel 1:1) vaani betoch haggola. hahu darga deikre ani, hu betoch haggola. ammay. al nehar kevar. al nahar denagid venafik defasik memoy umabbuoy vela ingid kad bekadmita (kidbekadmeta).

Hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 14:11) venahar yechorav veyavesh. yechorav bevayit rishon veyavesh bevayit sheni. uvegin kach hu hikka et shene ariel, moav. (sefer acher deha bekadmita) moav dehavu meav devishmaya veitcharvu veishtetziu begineh, vechol nehorin dehavu nehirin leyisrael kulhu itchashachu.

Vetu hu yarad vehikka et haari. bezimnin kadmain kad hay nahar hava mashich memoy letatta, havu kayyaymin yisrael bishlimu, dedabbechin divchin vekarbenin lechappara al nafshayyhu, ucheden hava nachit milleela diukena dechad arye vehavu chaman leh al gabbe madbecha ravitz al tarpeh, achil karbenin kigvar takkif. vechol kalbin havu mittamrin mikkammeh vela nafke levar.

Kevan degarmu chovin ihu nachit lego dargin diltatta vekatil lehahu arye, dela vaa lemehav leh tarpeh kidvekadmita, kivyachol katil leh. hu hikka et haari vadday. letoch habbor leenaha desitra ochora bisha. kevan dechamat hachi hahu sitra ochora ittakfat (242 80 behar 111) veshadderat lechad kalba lemechal karbenin. uma shemeh dehahu arye oriel deanpoy anpe arye. uma shemeh dehahu kalba beladan shemeh. delav ihu bichlal adam, ela kalba veanpe kalba.

Beyom hashsheleg beyoma degarmu chovin vedina itdan leela meim be dina illaa. veal da ketiv lo tira levetah mishshaleg da dina illaa. ammay begin dechol betah lavush shanim veyachil lemisbal eshsha takkifa. ad kan raza dikra.

Ma ketiv batreh (Shmuel 2 23:21) vehu hikka et ish mitzri ish mare. hacha raza dikra ata leodaa, di bechol zimna deyisrael chavu ihu istallak umena minnayyhu kol tavin vechol nehorin dehavu nehirin lon. hu hikka et ish mitzri da nehora dehahu nehora dehava nahir lon leyisrael. uman ihu moshe. dichtiv, (Shemot 2:19) vattomarna ish mitzri hitztzilanu vegomer. vetamman ityelid vetamman itrabbe vetamman istalik linhora illaa.

Ish mare kema deat amer (Bamidbar 12:8) umare velo vechidot. ish kema deat amer, (Devarim 33:1) ish haelohim. kivyachol baalah dehahu mare kevod Adonai. dezacha leanhaga darga da bechol reuteh beara (21 2) ma dela zache bar nash ochora.

Uveyad hammitzri chanit. da matte haelohim dehu itmasar bideh kema deat amer, (Shemot 17:9) umatte haelohim beyadi. veda ihu matte deitbere erev shabbat ben hashshemashot vechakuk beh shema kaddisha gelifa kaddisha uvehay chav bassela kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 20:11) vayyach et hassela bemattehu paamayim. amar leh kudesha berich hu, moshe la yehavit lach matte dili lehay, chayyecha lo yehe veyadcha mikkan ulehala.

Miyyad (28 2) vayyered elav bashshevet bedina kashya (Shmuel 2 23:21) vayyigzol et hachanit miyyad hammitzri. dimhahi shaata itmena minneh vela hava bideh lealmin. vayyahargehu bachanito. al hahu chova dimcha behahu matte, met vela al leara kaddisha veitmena nehora da miyyisrael.

(Shmuel 2 23:19) min hashsheloshim (105 2) hachi nichbad, illen sheloshim shana illain deihu natil minhon veingid letatta, uminnayyhu ihu hava natil veitkarev. veel hashshelosha lo va, innun havu atyan legabbeh veyahave leh biruta delibba, veihu la have ate legabbehon.
Veaf al gav dela al beminyayna vechushebna (dechushebana) dilhon, (Shmuel 2 23:23) vayshimehu david el mishmato. dela itperash millucha delibbeh
12: Lealmin. let piruda lehon lealmin. david sam leh libbeh veihu lav ledavid. begin detushebchan veshirin verachamin desihara avid leshimsha, ihi meshichat leh legabbah lemehve diyyureh bahadah. veda ihu vaysimehu david el mishmato.

Naflu ribbi eliezer veribbi abba kammeh. adhachi vehachi la chamu leh. kamu veistakkalu lechol sitrin vela chamu leh. yatvu uvachu vela yachilu lemallala da leda. levatar shaata amar ribbi abba vadday ha detanenan debchol archa detzaddikayay azlin umile deorayyta benayyhu, deinnun zakkain dehahu alma atyan legabbehon. vadday da hu rav hamenuna sava deata legabban mehahu alma legallaa lan millin illen, vead la nishtemoda beh azal leh veitkasse minan. kamu vehavu bau lemitan lechamre vela azlu, bau lemitan velo azlu. dechilu veanchu lon lechamre. vead yoma havu karan lehahu atar, duch dechamare.

Patach ribbi elazar (31 2, 46 1, 18 1) veamar (Tehillim 31:20) ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha vegomer kamma hu tava illaa veyakkira dezammin kudesha berich hu lemebad gabbe beni nesha leinnun zakkain illain dachale cheta demishtaddele beorayyta kad alin lehahu alma. tuvecha la ketiv ela rav tuvecha. uman ihu (Tehillim 145:7) zecher rav tuvecha yabbiu. veda ihu innuga dechayyin denagdin mealma deate legabbe chay almin deihu zecher rav tuvecha. vadday ihu (Yeshayahu 63:7) verav tuv levet yisrael vegomer.
Tu ma rav tuvecha, hacha aglif raza dechachmeta vechol razin itkelilu hacha, ma, kema deitmar. rav da ilana rav vetakkif. begin deit ilana ochora zuta minneh, veda hu rav veail leh berum rekiin.

Tuvecha da or deitbere beyoma kadmaa. asher tzafanta lireecha begin deganiz leh letzaddikayyay behahu alma. paalta da gan eden illaa. dichtiv, (Shemot 15:17) machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai, veda hu paalta lachosim bach.
(Bereshit 46 amud bet) neged bene adam da gan eden diltatta lego metivta dirkia behahu gan eden dilela. ufarche veistachyayn betalle nahare afarsemona dachya venachate vesharan (vasherayyn) letatta.
Ulezimnin itchazun neged bene adam lemebad lon nissin kemalachin illain, kegavvna dechazena hasheta nehiru devutzina illaa vela zachina leistakkala uleminda razin dechachmata yattir.

Patach ribbi abba veamar (Shoftim 13:22) vayyomer manoach el ishto mot namut ki elohim rainu, af al gav demanoach la hava yada may avidteh, amar hoil uchetiv, (Shemot 33:20) ki lo yirani haadam vachay, vadday anan chazenan uvegin kach mot namut. veanan chamenan vezachenan linhora da dehava azil bahadan venitkayyem (vaatakeyymanea) bealma. deha kudesha berich hu shaddereh legabban leoda lan razin dechachmeta degale, zakkaa chulekana.

Azlu, metu lechad tura vehava nate shimsha. sharu anfin deilana detura leakasha da veda veamre shirata. ad dahavu azle, shemau chad kala takkifa dehava amar bene elahin kaddishin innun deitbadderu bene chayyay dehay alma, innun botzine bene metivta, itkanneshu leduchetayyhu leishtashea bemarechon beorayyta. dechilu illen vekaimu beduchetayyhu veyatve. addehachi nafik kala kemilkaddemin veamar tinnarin takifin pattishin ramin ha mare digvavnin merakma betziyyurin kaim al itztevavna, ulu veitkanshu.

Behahi shaata shemau kal anfe deilanin rav vetakkif vehavu amre (Tehillim 29:5) kol Adonai shover arazim. naflu al anpayhu ribbi elazar veribbi abba udechilu sagya nafal alayhu, kamu bivhilu veazlu vela shemau midi. nafku min tura veazlu.
Kad matu leve ribbi yose beribbi shimon ben lakonya chamu leribbi shimon ben yochay tamman. chadu
13: Chade (chada), ribbi shimon amar lon vadday archa denissin veatin illain ka avartun, deana damichna hasheta vechamena lechu velivnayahu ben yehoyada deka meshadder lechu teren itrin al yeda dechad sava leaattera lechu. vadday bearcha da kudesha berich hu hava. tu dachamena anpayychu meshanyayn. amar ribbi yose yaot amartun dechacham adif minnavi. ata ribbi elazar veshavvi reshe ben birkoy deavoy vesach (leh) ovada.

Dachil ribbi shimon uvecha amar (Chavakuk 3:2) Adonai shamati shimacha yareti. hay kera chavakkuk amar (amro) beshaata dechama mitateh veitkayyaym al yeda deelisha. ammay ikre chavakkuk. begin dichtiv, (Melachim 2 4:17) lammoed hazze kaet chayya at choveket ben. veda bereh (bera) deshunammit hava. uteren (beshallach 45 amud alef) chibbukin havu, chad deimeh vechad deelisha. dichtiv, (Melachim 2 4:34) vayyasem piv al piv.

Ashkachna besifra dishlomo malka, shema gelifa deshivin uteren shemahan aglif aloy betevin. begin deatvavn dealfa beta deaglif beh avoy bekadmita kad mit parchu minneh. vehasheta deelisha chavak leh aglif beh kol innun (beshallach nusach acher amud bet) atvavn deshivin uteren shemahan. veatvavn deilen shivin uteren shemahan gelifan innun matan veshittesar atvavn.

Vechulhu atvavn aglif berucheh (nusach acher badeybevarea) elisha, begin lekayyayma leh beatvavn deshivin uteren shemahan. ukera leh chavakkuk. shema deashlim lechol sitrin. ashlim lachavukin kidittemar. veashlim leraza dematan veshittesar (pikkude 246 amud bet) atvavn dishma kaddisha. betevin itkayyaym leahadara rucheh, uveatvavn itkayyaym kol gufeh al kiyyumeh. veal da ikre chavakuk.

Veihu amar (Chavakuk 3:2) Adonai shamati shimacha yareti, shemana ma dehava li deatimna mehahu alma vedachilna. shera lemitba rachamin al nafsheh veamar (nasha 138 amud bet) Adonai paalcha deavadt li bekerev shanim yehon chayyehu. kemo chayyav. vechol man deitkashshar beinnun shanim kadmoniyyot chayyin itkashru beh. bekerev shanim todia lehahu darga delet (bah) chayyin kelal.

Bacha ribbi shimon veamar uf ana mimma deshamana dachilna lekudesha berich hu. zakif yedoy al resheh veamar uma rav hamenuna sava nehiru deorayyta zechitun attun lemechome appin beappin vela zachina beh. nafal al anpoy vechama leh meakker turin manhir sheragin behechla demalka meshicha. amar leh ribbi behahu alma tehon shevavin mare ulepnin kamme kudesha berich hu. mehahu yoma hava kare leribbi elazar bereh uleribbi abba (9 1) peniel kema deat amer, (Bereshit 32:31) ki raiti elohim panim el panim.

Bereshit ribbi chiyyay patach (Tehillim 111:10) reshit (11 2) chachma yirat Adonai sechel tov lechol osehem tehillato omedet laad. reshit chachma, hay kera hachi mibbae leh, sof chachma yirat Adonai, begin deyirat Adonai sof chachma ihi. (nusach acher ella ihi reshit) leala lego darga dechachmeta illaa hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek. ze hashshaar laAdonai vadday, dei la yeul behay tara la yeul lealmin. lemalka illaa deihi (deihu) illaa vetamir veganiz veavid leh tarin illen al illen

Ulesof kol tarin avad tara chad bechamma manulin bechamma pitchin bechamma hechalin illen al illen. amar kol man devae lemeal legabbay tara da yehe kadmaa legabbay, man deyeol behay tara yeul. uf hachi tara kadmaa lechachma illaa yirat Adonai ihi. veda ihi reshit

2, Teren innun demitchabberin kechada, veinnun teren nekudin, chad geniza utemira vechad kayyayma beitgalleya. uvegin delet lehu piruda ikrun rishit. chad vela teren. man denatil hay natil hay. vechola chad deha hu (shemeh) ushemeh chad dichtiv, (Tehillim 83:19) veyedu ki atta shimcha Adonai levaddecha.
Ammay ikre yirat Adonai, begin deihu ilana detov vera, zache bar nash ha tov vei la zache ha (hu) ra.
14: Veal da share behay atar yira. veda tara leala lechol tuva dealma. sechel tov illen teren tarin deinnun kechada. ribbi yose amar sechel tov da ilana dechayye deihu sechel tov bela ra kelal. veal dela sharya beh ra ihu sechel tov bela ra.

Lechol osehem, illen chasde david (vaychi 219 amud alef) hanneemanim tamchin orayyta. veinnun detamchin orayyta kivyachol innun avdin. kol innun delaan beorayyta let behu asiyya beod delaan bah. innun detamchin lon it behu asiyya. uvechela da ketiv tehillato omedet laad vekayyma kuresyay al kiyyumeh kedka yeut.

Ribbi shimon hava yativ velae beorayyta belelya (emor 98 1) dechalla itchabberat bevaalah. detaninan kol innun chavraya divne hechala dechalla itzterichu behahi lelya dechalla izdamnat lemeheve leyoma achara go chuppa bevaalah lemehve immah kol hahu lelya, ulemechede immah betikkunaha deihi ittakkanat lemile beorayyta mittora linviim uminviim lichtuvim uvemidrashot dikrae uveraze dechachmeta. begin deillen innun tikkunin dilah vetachshitaha. veihi veulemtaha alat vekayymat al reshehon veittakkanat behu vechadat behu kol hahu lelya. uleyoma ochora la alat lachuppa ella bahadayyhu. veillen ikrun bene chuppata. vechevan dealat lechuppata kudesha berich hu shail alayyhu umevarech lon umeatter lon beitteraha dechalla. zakkaa chulakhon.

Vehava ribbi shimon vechulhu chavrayay (bahadeh) merannenin berinna deorayyta umechaddeshan millin deorayyta kol chad vechad minnayyhu. vehava chade ribbi shimon vechol shear chavrayay. amar lon ribbi shimon, banay zakkaa chulakchon begin dilmachar la teul kalla lachuppa ella bahadayychu. begin dechulhu dimtaknin tikkunaha behay lelya vechadan bah kulhu yehon reshimin uchetivin besifra deduchranaya vekudesha berich hu mevarech lon beshivin birchan veitterin dealma illaa.

Patach ribbi shimon veamar (Tehillim 19:2) (teruma 136 2) hashshamayim mesapperim kevod el vegomer kera da ha okimna leh. aval bezimna da dechalla itara lemeal lachuppa beyoma demachar ittakkanat veitnehirat bekishutaha bahade chavrayay dechadan immah kol hahi lelya veihi chadat immehon.

Uveyoma demachar kamma uchelusin (kema) chayyaylin umashshiryayn mitkanshin bahadah. veihi vechulhu mechakkan lechol chad vechad ditkinu lah behay lelya. kevan demitchabberan kechada veihi chamat levalah ma ketiv hashshamayim mesapperim kevod el. hashshamayim da chatan deal lachuppa. mesapperim, menaharin kezohara desappir, denahir vezahir misyayfe alma vead seyayfe alma.

Kevod el, da kevod kalla deikre el, dichtiv, (tehillim 7) el zoem bechol yom. bechol yome shatta ikre el, vehasheta deha alat lachuppa ikre kavod, veikre el. yekar al yekar. nehiru al nehiru. veshaltanu al shaltanu.

Keden behahi shaata deshamayim al lachuppa veate venahir lah, kol innun chavrayyay deatkinu lah kulhu itparshe (itparshu) bishmahan tamman hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 19:2) umaase yadav maggid harakia. maase yadav, illen innun mare kayyayma divrit bahade chala, veinnun mare kayayma divrit ikrun maase yadav, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 90:17) umaase yadenu konnehu da berit kayyayma dechatim bevisra devar nash.

Rav hamenuna sava amar hachi (Kohelet Adonai:Adonai) al titten et picha lachati et besarecha, dela yahiv bar nash pumeh lemete lehirhura bisha, vihe garim lemechote lehahi besar kodesh dechatim beh berit kaddisha. deillu avid ken mashchin leh legehinnom. vehahu dimmune al gehinnom dum shemeh. vechamma ribbo demalache chabbala bahadeh. vekaim al pitcha degehinnom, vechol innun denatru berit kaddisha behay alma, let leh reshu lemikrav behu.
David malka beshata deira leh hahu ovada dachil. behahi shaata salik dum kamme kudesha berich hu veamar leh mare dealma
15: Ketiv battora (Vayikra 20:10) veish asher yinaf et eshet ish. uchetiv veel eshet amitcha vegomer. david dekilkel berit beerva mahu. amar leh kudesha berich hu david zakkaa hu, uverit kaddisha al tikkuneh kayyma, deha gele kadamay deizdammenat leh bat sheva miyyoma deitbere alma.

Amar leh i kammach gale kammeh la gale. amar leh vetu behettera hava ma dehava. deha kol innun dealu likrava la al chad minnayyhu ad deaftar beget leinteteh. amar leh i hachi hava leh leorcha telat yarche vela orich. amar leh bemay okim milla beatar dechayyshinan dehi meubberet, vegale kodamay deuriyya la kariv bah lealmin deha shemi chatim begavveh lesahaduta. ketiv uriyya uchetiv uriyyahu shemi chatum bahadeh (bahadayyhu) dela shimmesh bah lealmin.

Amar leh, mare dealma ha ma deamarit i kammach gale dela shechiv bahadah uriyya, kammeh mi gale, hava leh leorcha lah telat yarche. vetu i yada dela shechiv bahadah lealmin ammay shadar lah david ufeked aleh leshammasha beinteteh dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 11:8) red levetcha urechatz raglecha.

Amar leh vadday la yada, aval yattir mittelat yarche orich deha arba yarche havu. dehachi taninan bachamishsha veesrim denisan aavar david karoza bechol yisrael, vehavu im yoav beshiva yomin desivan veazlu vechabbalu ara divni ammon. sivan vetammuz veav veelul ishtahu sham. uvearbaa veesrim beelul hava ma dehava mibbat sheva. uveyoma dechippure machal leh kudesha berich hu, hahu chova. veit deamre bez beadar aavar karoza veitkannashu bechamesar deiyyayr, uvechamesar beelul hava ma dehava mibbat sheva, uveyoma dechippura itbesar (Shmuel 2 12:13) gam Adonai heevir chattatcha lo tamut. may lo tamut, lo tamut bida deduma.

Amar duma mare dealma ha milla chada it li gabbeh deihu aftach pumeh veamar (Shmuel 2 12:5) chay Adonai ki ben mavt haish haose zot veihu dan lenafsheh teronyay it li aleh. amar leh, let lach reshu deha ode legabbay veamar chatati laAdonai veaf al gav dela chav. aval bamme dechata beuriyya onasha ketavit aleh vekibbel. miyyad ahadar duma leatreh befache nefesh.

Veal da amar david (Tehillim 94:17) lule (94 1) Adonai ezrata li kimat shachna duma nafshi. lule Adonai ezrata li dehava appotroppa dili. kimat shachna vegomer. mahu kimat, kechuta dakkik keshiura deit beni uven sitra ochora, kehahu shiura havat dela shachna duma nafshi.

Uvegin kach bae leistamra bar nash dela yema milla kedavid. begin dela yachil lememar leduma (Kohelet 5) ki shegaga hi, kema dehava ledavid venatzach leh kudesha berich hu bedina. lamma yiktzof haelohim al kolech al hahu kol deihu amar. vechibbel et maase yadecha da besar kodesh berit kaddisha defagim veitmeshach begehinnom al yeda deduma.

Uvegin kach (Tehillim 19:2) umaase yadav maggid harakia illen innun chavrayyay deitchabbaru bechalla da umare kayyayma dilah. maggid verashim kol chad vechad. man harakia. da ihu (34 1) harakia deveh chamma ulevana vechochvaya umazzale, veda ihu sefer (yitro daf amud alef) zikkarun. ihu maggid verashim lehu uchetiv lehu lemeheve beni hechala ulemebad reutehon tadir.

(Tehillim 19:3) yom leyom yabbia omer, yoma kaddisha meinnun yomin illain demalka meshabbechin lon lechavrayay veamrin hahi milla deamar kol chad lechavreh. yoma leyoma yabbia hahu omer umeshabbach leh. velayla lelayla kol darga deashlim (nusach acher deshallit) belelya meshabbach da leda hahu daat dechol chad mechavreh, uvishlimu (sefer acher uvirchimu) sagge itavidu lon chavrin urechimin.
En omer veen devarim bishar milin dealma. dela ishtamu kamme malka kaddisha vela bae lemishma lon. aval hane mile bechol haaretz yatza kavam. avde
16: Meshicha innun millin medori illae umedore tattae (leel daf Adonai 2), meillin itavidu rekiin umeillen eretz mehahi tushebachta. vei tema deinnun millin beatar chad. meshatteta bealma biktze tevel millehem.
Vechevan deitavida (deitavid) rekiin minhon, man sharya vehon. hadar veamar lashshemesh sam ohel bahem. hahu shimsha kaddisha shave medoreh umishkaneh behu veitattar behu.

Kevan deshare beinnun rekiin veitattar behu, keden vehu kechatan yotze mechuppato. chade verahit beinnun rekiin. nafak minnayyhu veal verahit go migdela chada ochora beatar ochora. miktze hashshamayim motzao, vadday mealma illaa nafik veatya (vaata) deihu (leel 1 2) ketze hashshamayim leela. utekufato (al ketzotam), man tekufato, da ketze hashshamayim letatta deihi tekufat hashshana deaschera lechol sayyfin. veitkashrat min hashshamayim ad rekia da. veen nistar mechammato dehahi tekufa da utekufa deshimsha deaschar bechol sitra.

Veen nistar let deitkasse minneh mikkol dargin illain dehavu kulhu mesacharan veatyayn legabbeh vechol chad vechad let man deyitkasse mineh. mechammato beshata deitchamem vetav (vateayb) legabbayyhu bitteyuveta (betiuveta) shelim. kol shevacha da vechol illuya da begin orayyta hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 19:8) torat Adonai temima.

Shit zimnin ketiv hacha Adonai, veshit kerae min hashshamayim mesapperim ad torat Adonai temima veal raza da ketiv bereshit ha shit atvavn. bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz, ha shit tevin. kerae acharanin lokovel shit zimnin Adonai shit kerae begin shit atvavn dehacha. shit shemahan begin shit tevin dehacha.

Ad dehavu yatve alu ribbi elazar bereh veribbi abba. amar lon vadday anpe shechinta atyayn, veal (7 2) da peniel karena lechu, deha chamittun anpe shechinta appin beappin. vehasheta deka yedatun vegale lechu kera deuvenayahu ben yehoyada, vadday demilla deattika kaddisha ihu ukera deabbatreh. vehahu desatim mikkola amru.

Vehay kera ihu beatar ochora kegavvna da. patach veamar (daberayhaymaym 1 11) vehu hikka et haish hammitzri ish midda chamesh baamma, vechola raza chada ihu, mehay (sefer acher hay) mitzri, hahu deishtemoda, (Shemot 11:3) gadol meod beeretz mitzrayim beene avde vegomer rav veyakkira kema degale hahu sava.

Vehay kera bimtivta illaa ittemar. ish midda kolla chad. (Shmuel 2 23) ish mare veish midda kolla chad. begin (leel Adonai amud bet) deihu shabbat utechuma dichtiv, (Bamidbar 35:5) umaddotem michutz lair, uchetiv, (Vayikra 19:35) lo taasu avel bammishpat bammidda. veal da ish midda ihu. veihu mammash ish midda ihu arkeh misseyayfe alma vead seyayfe alma. adam harishon hachi hava. vei tema ha ketiv chamesh baamma. innun chamesh baamma misseyayfe alma ad seyayfe alma hava.

(Divrei hayamim 1 11:23) uveyad hammitzri chanit kema deat amer kimnor orgim, da matte haelohim dehava bideh chakik bishma gelifa mefarash binhiru detzerufe atvavn dehava galif betzalel umetivta dileh deikre oreg dichtiv, (Shemot 35:35) mille otam vegomer charash vechoshev verokem vegomer. vehahu matte hava nahir shema gelifa bechol sitrin binhiru dechachimin dehavu megallefin shema mefarash (pikkude 260 1) bearbein uteren goone. ukera mikkan ulehala kema deamar zakkaa chulakeh.

Tivu yakkirin tivu unechaddesh tikkun dechalla behay lelya. dechol man deishtattaf bahadah behay lelya yehe netir ela vetatta kol hahi shatta veyappek shatta bishlam. alayyhu ketiv (Tehillim 35:5) chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem taamu ureu ki tov Adonai:

Patach ribbi shimon veamar bereshit bara elohim. hay kera it leistakkela beh. dechol man deamar it elaha ochora ishtetze mealmin. kema deittemar (Yirmeyahu 10:11) kidna temrun lehom elaha (elahaya) di shemaya vearka la avadu yevadu meara umin techot shemayya elle. begin delet elaha ochora bar kudesha verich hu bilchodoy.
17: Kera ihu targum bar mimmilla desof kera. i tema begin demalachin kaddishin la nizkakin letargum (58 75 1) vela ishtemodan beh, mila da yaot hi lememar belishna kaddisha begin deyishmeun malachin kaddishin vihon nizkakin leodaa al da. ella vadday begin kach ketiv targum dela nizkakin beh malachin kaddishin la (velo) yekanun bevar nash leavasha leh, begin divhay kera bichlala innun malachin kaddishin, deha innun elohim ikrun uvichlala deelohim havu, veinnun la avadu shemayya vearka.

Vearka, veara mibbae leh. ella begin (126 1) dearka ihi chada meinnun sheva arin diltatta. uvehahu atar it beni benoy dekayin. levatar deittarach meal appe ara (24 2) nachit letamman veavid toladot veishtabbash tamman dela yada kelum. veihu ara kefela deitkefal mechashocha unehora.

Veit tamman teren memannan shallitin di shaltin da bachashocha veda binhora. vetamman kitruga da veda. veshaata denachit letamman kayin, ishtetafu da veda veishtelimu kechada. vecholla chaze deinnun toldot dekayin. veal da innun bitren reshin kitren chevavn, bar dechad hahu nehora shalit natzach dileh venatzach al ochora. veal da itkelilu di bachashocha binhora vehavu chad.
Innun teren memannan afrira vekastimon. vediyyukena dilhon kidiukena demalachin kaddishin beshit gadfin. chad diukena ketora, vechad diukena kenishra. vechad mitchabberan itavidu diukena deadam.

Kad innun bechashocha mithappechin liddeyokna denachash bitren reshin veazlin kechivya vetasin go tehoma veistachyayn beyamma rabba. kad matan leshalshelaa deazza vaazael margizin lon umitare lon. veinnun medalgin go ture chashochan vechashve dekudesha berich hu bae lemitba lon dina.

Veillen teren memannan shatin beyamma rabba ufarchin mittamman veazlin belelya legabbe (19 2, 55 2) naama imhon deshedin detao avatraha dachalin kadmain vechashvin lemikrav legabbah. veihi deligat shittin alfin parsin veitavidat bechamma tziyyurin legabbe bene nesha begin deyitun bene nesha avatrah.
Veillen teren memannan parchin umeshattetan bechol alma veahadderan leatrayyhu. veinnun mitarin leinnun bene benoy dekayyin berucha deyitzrin bishin lemebad toladot.

Shemayya deshaltin tamman lav kehani. vela olidat ara bechela dilhon zeroa (338 172 1) vechatzda kehane. vela ahadderan ella bechamma shenin vezimnin. veinnun elaha (elahaya) di shemaya vearka la avadu. yevadu meara illaa detevel, dela yishletun bah vela yeshattun bah vela yehon garmin livni nasha leistoova mimikre lelya. veal da yevadu meara umin techot shemaya deitavidu (leel daf 3 1) bishma deelle kema (2 1) deittemar.
Veal da hay kera targum dela yachshevun malache illae dealayyhu amrin, vela yekatregu lan. veal da raza deelle kema deittemar ihu milla kaddisha dela itchallaf battargum.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, hay kera dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:7) mi (Shemot 95 amud bet) la yiraacha melech haggoyim ki lecha yaata, may shevacha ihu. amar leh elazar beri, hay kera bechamma duchete ittemar, aval vadday lav ihu (nusach acher hachi) dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:7) ki vechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam deha ata lemiftach puma dechayyayvin dechashvin dekudesha berich hu la yeda hirhurin umachshavin dilhon. uvegin kach it leodaa shetuta dilhon. dezimna chada ata pilosofa chada deumot haolam legabbay, amar li attun amrin deelahachon shallit bechol rume shemaya. kulhun chayyaylin umashshiryayn la iddabbekan vela yade atar dileh. hay kera la asge yekareh kol kach. dichtiv ki vechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam meen kamocha. may shikkula da livne nasha di let
18: Vetu deattun amrin (Devarim la) velo kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe, beyisrael lo kam aval beumot haolam kam. uf hachi ana ema bechol chachme haggoyim en kamohu, aval bechachme yisrael it. i hachi elaha deit bechachme yisrael kevavteh lav ihu illaa shallita. istakkal bakkera vetishkach dedayyikna kedka yeut.

Amina leh vadday shappir ka amart. man mechayye metim ella kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, ata eliyyahu veelisha veachayu metayay. man morid geshamim ella kudesha berich hu bilchodoy ata eliyyahu umena lon unechit lon bitzloteh. man avad shemayya veara ella kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, ata avraham itkayaymu bekiyyumohi begineh.

Man manhig shimsha ella kudesha berich hu, ata yehoshua veshachich leh ufakkid leh deyekum al kiyyumeh veishtechach uchetiv, (Yehoshua 10:13) vayyiddom hashshemesh veyareach amad. kudesha berich hu gozer gezar din uf hachi moshe gazir gezar din veitkayyaymu. vetu dekudesha berich hu gozer gizrin vetzaddikayya deyisrael mevattelin lo dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 23:3) tzaddik moshel yirat elohim. vetu deihu pakkid lon lemhach beorchoy mammash leitdema leh becholla. azal hahu pilosofa veitgayyayr bichfar shechalayim vekarun leh yose ketinaa. veolif orayyta sagya. veihu ben chakkimin vezakkain dehahu atar.

Hasheta it leistakkela bakkera veha ketiv, (Yeshayahu 40:17) kol haggoyim keayin negdo. may ribbuya hacha. ella mi la yiraacha melech haggoyim vechi melech haggoyim ihu velav melech yisrael. ella bechol atar kudesha berich hu baa leishtabbacha beyisrael, vela itkere ela al yisrael bilchodoy. dichtiv, (Shemot Adonai:3) elohe yisrael elohe haivrim, uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 44:6) ko amar Adonai melech yisrael. melech yisrael vadday. amru umot haolam patron ochoran it lan bishmaya deha malchechon la shalit ela alayychu bilchodechon vealana la shalit.

Ata kera veamar mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim (nusach acher malka ilaa laredaah lon ulealkaa lon ulemebad behon reuteh. ki lecha yeete ledachala minnach leella vetatta. ki bechol chachme haggoyim) illen shallitin ravrevan di memannan alayyhu. uvechol malchutam behahu malchu dilela. deha arba malkevavn shallitin it leela veshaltin biruteh al kol shear ammin. veim kol da let behu deyaavid afillu milla zeera ella kema depakkid lon dichtiv, (Daniel 4:32) uchemitzbeye avid bechel shemaya vedayyre ara. chachme haggoyim innun memannan veravrevan dilela dechachmeta dilhon minnayyhu hava. bechol malchutam malchuta deshalit kema deittemar. veda hu kera kifshateh.

Aval bechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam. hay ashkachna besifre kadmae, deinnun mashshiryayn vechayaylin af al gav deitpakkedan al millin dealma ufakkid lechol chad lemebad avidta, man hu (setima kaddisha velo kareavetayh) deyaavid shum chad minnayyhu kamocha. begin deant rashim beiluya, veat rashim beovadach mikkullehu. veda hu meen kamocha Adonai, man hu setimaa kaddisha deyaavid veleheve kamocha ela vetatta. vihe dame lach (bechol) (bechola), ovada demalka kaddisha shamayim vaaretz, aval innun (yeshaya ma) tohu vachamudehem bal yoilu. bekudesha berich hu ketiv bereshit bara elohim vegomer, bemalchutam ketiv vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu.

Amar ribbi shimon lechavrayay bene hillula da, kol chad minnechon yekashshet kishshuta chad lekalla. amar leribbi elazar bereh. elleazar hav nevazbeza chad lekalla deha lemachar istakkal (kudesha berich hu) (nusach acher bah) kad yeul lachuppa beinnun shirin ushevachin deyahavu lah bene hechala lekayyeyma kammeh.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar (Shir HaShirim 3:6) mi (176 2) zot ola min hammidbar vegomer, mi zot, kelala ditren kiddushin (kaddishin) ditren almin bechibbura chada vekishshura chada. ola mammash lemehve kodesh kadashin. deha kodesh kadashin mi. veitchabbera bezot. begin lemeheve (zot) ola deihi kodesh kadashin. min hammidbar deha min hammidbar yarta lemeheve challa ulemeal lechuppa.
Tu min hammidbar ihi ola kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 4:3) umidbarech nave behahu midbar
19: Dilchishu besifvavn ihi ola. vetaninan may dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 4:8) haelohim haaddirim haelle elle hem haelohim hammakkim et mitzrayim bechol makka bammidbar. vechi kol deavad lon kudesha berich hu bammidbar hava, veha beyishshuva hava. ella bammidbar, bedibbura, kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 4:3) umidbarech nave. uchetiv, (Tehillim 75:7) mimmidbar harim. uf hachi ola min hammidbar, min hammidbar vadday. behahi milla defuma ihi salka veoolat ben gadfe deimma, ulevatar bedibbura nachta vesharya al reshayhu deamma kaddisha.

Hecha salka bedibbura. deha besheruta kad bar nash kaim betzafra it leh levarcha lemareh. beshata defakach enoy hech mevarech. hachi havu avde chaside kadmae, natla demayay havu yahave kamayyhu, uvezimna deitaru belelya aschan yedayyhu. vekayyme velaan beorayyta umevarche al keriatah (vechulei). tarnegola kare ucheden palgut lelya mammash, ucheden kudesha berich hu (60 2) ishtakkach im tzaddikayay beginta deeden, veassir levarcha bidayin mesoavot umezhamot. (umevarchin). vechen kol shaata.

Begin divshaata devar nash naim, rucheh parcha minneh. uveshaata derucheh parcha minneh, rucha mesaava zammin vesharya al yedoy umesaav lon veassir levarcha behu bela netila. vei tema i hachi ha bimama dela naim vela parach rucheh minneh vela sharya aleh rucha mesaava vechad al levet hakkisse la yevarech vela yikra battora afillu milla chada ad deyische yedoy. vei tema begin dimluchelachim innun, lav hachi hu, bamme itlachlechu.

Ella vavy livne alma dela mashgichin vela yadin beyikra demarehon vela yade al ma kayyma alma. rucha chada it bechol bet hakkisse dealma desharya tamman veithanni mehahu lichlucha vetinnufa umiyyad share al innun etzbean didoy devar nash.
Patach ribbi shimon veamar kol man dechade beinnun moadayya vela yahiv chulakeh lekudesha berich hu, hahu ra ayin satan sone oto veka mekatreg leh vesalik leh mealma vechamma aku al aku mesabbev leh.

Chulakeh dekudesha berich hu, lemechode lemiskene kefum ma deyachil lemebad. begin dekudesha berich hu beyomayyay illen ate lemechome leinnun manin tevirin dileh, veal alayyhu vechame dela it lehon lemechede, uveche alayyhu. salik leela (uvae) lecharba alma.

Atan bene metivta kammeh veamre ribbon alma, rachum vechannun itkeriat yitgalgelun rachamach al benach. amar lon vechi (bene) alma la (yadin dela) avdit leh ella al chesed dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:3) amarti olam chesed yibbane, vealma al da kayyma. amre kammeh malache illae, ribbon alma ha pelanya deachil verave veyachil lemebad tivu im miskeni vela yahiv lon midi. ate hahu mekatrega uteva reshu uredaf avatreh dehahu bar nash.

Man lan bealma gadol meavraham deavad tivu lechol biryayn. beyoma deavad mishteyay, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 21:8) vayyigdal hayyeled vayyiggamal, vayyaas avraham mishte gadol beyom higgamel et yitzchak. avad avraham mishteyay ukera lechol ravreve dara lehahi seudata. vetaninan bechol seudata dechedva, hahu mekatrega azil vechame i hahu bar nash akdim tivu lemiskene, umiskene beveta, hahu mekatrega itperash mehahu beta vela al tamman, vei lav al tamman. vechame irbuveya dechedva bela miskeni uvela tivu deakdim lemiskene, salik leela umekatrega aleh.

Avraham kevan dezammin leravreve dara, nachat mekatrega vekam al pitcha kegavvna demiskena vela hava man deashgach beh. avraham hava meshamesh leinnun malchin veravrevin. shara onikat benin lechullehu, dela havo mehemnin kad ihi olidat ella amru asufi hu umin shuka aytiu leh. begin kach atyayn benayyhu bahadayyhu venatlat lon sara veonikat lon kamayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 21:7) mi millel
20: Leavraham henika vanim sara, banim vadday. vehahu mekatrega al pitcha. amra (sara) tzechok asa li elohim. miyyad salik hahu mekatrega kamme kudesha berich hu veamar leh ribbon alma at amart avraham ohavi, (ha avraham) avad seudeta vela yahav lach midi, velav lemiskeni, vela kariv kadamach afillu yona chad. vetu amrat sara dechayychat bah.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu man bealma keavraham. velo zaz mittamman, ad devilbel kol hahi chedva, ufakkid kudesha berich hu lemikrav leyitzchak karbena, veitgezar al sara detamut al tzaara divrah. kol hahu tzaara garim, dela yahiv midi lemiskene.

Patach ribbi shimon veamar may dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 38:2) vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vayyitpallel el Adonai. ta chaze, kamma hu chela takkifa deorayyta, vechamma hu illaa al kola. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta la dachil meillae umittattae. velo dachil mimmarin bishin dealma. begin deihu achid beilana dechayye veyallif minneh bechol yoma.

Deha orayyta tolif levar nash lemezal beorach keshot. tolif leh eta hech yatuv kamme mareh levatla hahi gezera. deafillu itgezar aleh dela yitbattel hay gezera, miyyad itbattel veistallak minneh vela sharya aleh devar nash behay alma. uvegin kach bae leh levar nash leishtaddela beorayta yemama velele vela yitade minah hada hu dichtiv (Yehoshua 1:8) vehagita vo yomam valayla. vei itadde minnah deorayyta o itperash minah keillu itperash meilana dechayye.

Ta chaze, eta levar nash, kad ihu salik belelya al arseh bae lekabbela aleh malchuta dilela belibba shelim uleakdema lemimsar kammeh pikdona denafsheh (Bereshit 19 amud bet) umiyyad ishteziv mikkol marin bishin umikkol ruchin bishin vela shaltin aleh.

Uvetzafra kam mearseh bae levarcha lemareh ulemeal leveteh ulemisgad kamme hechaleh bidchilu saggeya, uvatar ken yitzle tzeloteh veyissav eta meinnun avahan kaddishin dichtiv, (Tehillim Adonai:8) vaani berov chasdecha avo vetecha eshtachave el hechal kadshecha beyiratecha.

Hachi ukemuha la libbae leh levar nash leoola leve kenishta ella i amlich bekadmita beavraham yitzchak veyaakov, begin deinnun tekinu tzelota lekame kudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv vaani berov chasdecha avo vetecha, da avraham. eshtachave el hechal kadshecha, da yitzchak. beyiratecha, da yaakov. uvae leachlala lon beresha, uvatar ken yeul leve kenishta vitzalle tzeloteh. keden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Ribbi pinchas hava shechiach kamme deribbi rechumai bechef yamma deginosar. uvar nash rav ukeshisha deyomin hava veenoy istallaku millemechome. amar leribbi pinchas vadday shemana deyochai chavrana it leh margalit even tava, veistakkelit binhora dehahi margalit nafka kinhiru deshimsha minnartekah venahara kol alma.

Vehahu nehora kaim mishmayya leara venahir kol alma ad deyativ attik yomin veyativ al kurseyay kedka yeut. vehahu nehora kalil kolla bevetach. uminnehora deitkelil bevetach. nafak nehiru dakkik uzeer venafik levar venahir kol alma, zakkaa chulakach. pok beri, pok, zil abbatreh dehahi margalit denahir alma, deha shaata kayyma lach.

Nafak mikkammeh vekaim lemeal behahi arba uteren guverin bahadeh. chama teren tzipporin dehavu atyayn vetasin al yamma, ramma lon kala veamar tzipporin tzipporin deattun tasin al yamma, chametun duch devar yochai tamman, ishtahe pureta amar, tzipporin tzipporin zilu veativu li. parchu veazilu, alu beyamma veazle lehon.

Ad denafak, ha innun tzipporin atyayn uvefuma dechada minayyhu pitka chada uchetiv begavvav deha bar yochai nafak min mearta (hu) veribbi elazar bereh. azal legabbeh veashkach leh meshanya vegufeh malya chaludin. bacha
21: Bahadeh veamar vavy dachamitich bechach. amar zakkaa chulaki dachamet li bechach deilmale la chamita li bechach la havena bechach patach ribbi shimon befikkude orayyta. veamar pikkude orayyta deyahav kudesha berich hu leyisrael kulhu beorayyta beorach kelal ketive:

Berishit bara elohim. hada hi pikkuda kadmaa decholla. veikre pikkuda da yirat Adonai deikre reshit. dichtiv, (Tehillim 111:10) reshit chachma yirat Adonai. (Mishlei 1:7) yirat Adonai reshit daat. begin demilla da reshit ikre. veda ihi tara leaala go mehemnuta. veal pikkuda da itkeyyaym kol alma.

Yira itperash litlat sitrin. teren minnayyhu let behu ikara kedka yeut, vechad ikkara deyira. it bar nash dedachil mokudesha berich hu begin deyechon benohi vela yemutun. o dachil meonsha degufeh o demamoneh. veal da dachil leh tadir. ishtechach yira deihu dachil lekudesha berich hu la shave leikkera. it bar nash dedachil min kudesha berich hu begin dedachil meonasha dehahu alma veonasha degehinnom. teren illen lav ikkara deyira innun vesharsha dileh.

Yira deihi ikkara, lemidchal bar nash lemareh begin deihu rav veshallit ikkara vesharsha dechol almin vecholla kammeh kela chashivin. kema deittemar (Daniel 4:32) vechol dayyre ara kela chashivin. uleshava reuteh behahu atar deikre (nusach acher 2) yira.

Bacha ribbi shimon veamar vavy i ema vavy i la ema. i ema yindeun chayyayvin hech yiflechun lemarehon. i la ema yovdun chavrayyay milla da. beatar deyira kaddisha share, millera it yira raa delake umache umekatreg veihi retzua lealkaa chayyayvayya.

Uman dedachil begin onesh demalkeyuta vekitruga kema deittemar. la sharya aleh hahi yirat Adonai deikre yirat Adonai lechayyim. ella man sharya aleh hahi yira raa. veishtechach desharya aleh hahi retzua yira raa velo yirat Adonai.

Uvegin kach atar deikre yirat Adonai reshit daat ikre. veal da itkelil hacha pikkuda da. veda ikkara visoda lechol shear pikkudin deorayyta. man denatir yira (da) natir kolla. la natir yira la natir pikkude orayyta, deha da tara decholla.

Uvegin kach ketiv bereshit deihi yira, bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz. deman deavar al da avar al pikkude deorayyta. veonsha deman deavar al da hay retzua raa alke leh. vehayeynu vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu vechoshech al pene tehom veruach elohim. ha illen arba onashin leaanasha behon chayyayvayya.

Tohu da chenek, dichtiv, (yeshaya la) kav tohu (Zecharya 2:Adonai) chevel midda. bohu da sekila, avnin dimshukain go tehoma rabba leonsha dechayyayvayya. vechoshech da serefa, dichtiv, (Devarim Adonai:20) vayhi keshamachem et hakkol mittoch hachoshech (Devarim 4:11) vehahar boer baesh ad lev hashshamayim choshech kulei. veda eshsha takkifa deal reshehon dechayyayvayya share leokda lon.

Veruach da hereg besayyayf. ruach seara charba meshannena hi melahata beh. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 3:24) veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet veikre ruach. hay onasha leman deyaavar al pikkude orayyta. uchetiv levatar yira, reshit, deihi kelala decholla. mikkan vahala shear pikkudin deorayyta.

Pikkuda tinyayna da ihi pikkuda. defikkuda deyira itachadat bah vela nafka minah lealmin. veihi ahava. lemircham bar nash lemareh rechimu shelim. uman ihu rechimu shelim. da ahava rabba dichtiv, (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim shelim birchimuta. veda hu dichtiv vayyomer elohim yehi or da rechimu shelemuta deikre (pikkude 254 2) ahava rabba. vehacha ihu pikkuda lemircham bar nash lemareh kedka yeut.

Amar ribbi elazar, abba, rechimta bishlimu ana shemana beh. amar leh ema beri kamme deribbi pinchas deha ihu behay darga kaim. amar ribbi elazar ahava rabba hayeynu ahava shelemta bishlimu ditren sitrin, vei la itkelil bitren sitrin lav
22: Veal da taninan bitren sitrin itperash ahava rechimu dekudesha berich hu. it man derachim leh miggo deit leh utara, orka deyomin, benin sacharaneh, shallit al sanoy, archoy mittakkenan leh, umigo kach rachim leh. vei lehay yehe behippucha vihaddar aleh kudesha berich hu gilgula dedina kashya, yehe sanya leh vela yirchem leh kelal. uvegin kach rechimu da lav ihu ahava deit leh ikkara.

Rechimu deikre shelim hahu dehave bitren sitrin ben bedina ben betivu. vetikkuna dearchoy derachim leh lemareh kema ditnenan afillu hu natil nishmatach minach. da ihu rechimu shelim dehave bitrin sitrin (17 amud bet). veal da or demaase vereshit nafak ulevatar igniz. kad igniz nafak dina kashya veitkelilu teren sitrin kechada lemeheve shelimu da ahava kedka yeut.

Natleh ribbi shimon uneshakeh. ata ribbi pinchas uneshakeh uveracheh veamar bevadday kudesha berich hu shadderani hacha. da hu (leel daf 11 amud alef) nehiru dakkik deamru li deitkelil bevetai ulevatar nahir kol alma. amar ribbi elazar vadday la itzterich leitneshe yira bechol pikkudin, kol sheken befikkuda da itzterich yira leitdabbeka behay. hech itdabbeka. ahava ihi besitra chad tav kema deittemar deyahav utera vetav orka dechayye bene mezone, keden itzterich leatara yira ulemidchal dela yigrom chova. veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 28:14) ashre adam mefached tamid, begin deha kalil yira beahava.
