Vehachi itzterich besitra ochora dedina kashya leatara beh yira. kad chame dedina kashya sharya aloy, keden yitar yira veyidchal lemareh kedka yeut vela yakshe libbeh. veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 28:14) umakshe libbo yippol beraa. behahu sitra ochora deikre raa. ishtechach yira deitachadat bitren sitrin veitkelilat minnayyhu. veda ihu ahava shelemata kedka yeut.

Pikkuda telitaa leminda deit elaha ravreva veshallitaa bealma. uleyaychada leh bechol yoma yichuda kedka yaot beinnun shit sitrin ilain. ulemebad lon yichuda chada beshit tevin dishma yisrael ulechavvevna reuta leela bahadayyhu. veal da echad itzterich learka leh (nusach acher kasita) beshit tevin.

Veda hu dichtiv yikkavu hammayim mittachat hashshamayim el makom echad. yitkanneshun dargin ditchot shemaya leitachada beh (yire) lemeheve bishlimu leshit sitrin kedka yeut. veim kol da behahu yichuda itzterich lekashra beh yira deitzterich learka bedalet deechad. dedalet deechad gedola. vehayeynu dichtiv veterae hayyabbasha detitchaze vetitkashsher dalet deihu yabbasha behahu yichuda.

Ulevatar deitkashshar tamman leela itzterich lekashshera lah letatta beuchlusaha beshit sitrin ochoranin diltatta, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. deit beh shit tevin ochoranin deyichuda. keden ma dehavat yabbasha itavidat eretz lemebad perin veibbin ulenata ilanin.

Vehayeynu dichtiv vayyikra elohim layyabbasha eretz behahu yichuda diltatta ara raava shelim kedka yeut. veal da ki tov, ki tov tere zimne. chad yichuda ilaa vechad yichuda tattaa. kevan deitachid bitren sitrin mikkan ulehala taddeshe haaretz deshe. ittakkanat lemebad perin veibbin kedka yeut.

Pikkuda reviaa leminda de hu haelohim, kema deat amer, (Devarim 4:39) veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha ki Adonai hu haelohim. uleitkelala shema deelohim bishma dAdonai. leminda deinnun chad velet behu piruda.

Vehayenu raza dichtiv yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim lehair al haaretz. lemehve teren shemahan chad bela piruda kelal. leitkelala meorot chaser bishma deshamayim (nusach acher derashim) deinnun chad velet behu piruda. nehora uchema binhora chivvra let behu piruda vechola chad.
23: Veda hu anana chivvra dimama veanana deeshta belelya. (kema deamru chavrayyay) middat yom umidat layla. uleittakkan da beda leanhara kema deittemar lehair al haaretz.

Veda chova dehahu nachash kadmaa chibbar letatta veitperash leela. uvegin kach garam ma degaram lealma. begin deitzterich leafrasha letatta ulechabbera leela. unehora uchema itzterich leitachada leela bechibbura chada. uleitachada levatar beuchlusaha beyichudaha uleafrasha lah missitra bisha.

Veim kol da itzterich leminda deelohim Adonai kola chad bela piruda. Adonai hu haelohim. vechad yinda bar nash decholla chad vela yashve piruda, afillu hahi sitra ochora yistelak meal alma vela itmeshach letatta.

Vehayeynu raza dichtiv vehayu limorot. ha kelippa batar mocha salka. mocha or. sitra ochora mavet. or bechibbur deatvavn. mavet bepiruda. vechad hay or istallak mittamman, mitchabbara veatvavn mavet depiruda.

Meillen atvavn shariat chava vegarmat bisha al alma. kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:6) vattere haishsha ki tov ahadderat atvavn lemafrea ishtaar 46 veinnun azlu unetalu ot 416 bahadayyhu vegarmat mota al alma kema dichtiv vattere.

Amar ribbi elazar, abba, ha olifna mem ishtaarat yechidaa, vav deihu chayyin tadir ithappachat veazalat (pinchas 236 amud alef) unetalat 416 dichtiv vattikkach vattitten veishtelim teva da veitchabberu atvavn. amar leh berich ant beri veha okimna milla da.

Pikkuda chamishaa ketiv, (Bereshit 46 amud bet) yishretzu hammayim sheretz nefesh chaya. behay kera it telat pikkudin. chad lemile beorayyta. vechad leitasaka bifriyya ureviyya. vechad lemigzar litmanyay yomin uleaavara mittamman arlata. lemile beorayyta uleishtaddala vah uleappasha lah bechol yoma letakkena nafsheh verucheh.

Dechevan devar nash itassak beorayyta (58 62 amud alef) ittakkan (320 amud alef) benishmata ochora kaddisha. dichtiv sheretz nefesh chayya. nefesh dehahi chayya kaddisha. dechad bar nash la itassak beorayyta let leh nafsha kaddisha. kedusha dilela la sharya aloy. vechad ishtaddal beorayyta, behahu rechishu derachish bah zache lehahi nefesh chayya, ulemehedar kemalachin kaddishin.

Dichtiv, (Tehillim 103:20) barchu Adonai malachav, illen innun demitassekin beorayyta deikrun malachav beara. veda hu dichtiv veof yeofef al haaretz. hay behay alma. behahu alma taninan dezammin kudesha berich hu lemebad lon gadfin kenishrin uleashshata bechol alma dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:31) vekkoy Adonai yachalifu choach yaalu evar kannesharim.

Vehayenu dichtiv veof yeofef al haaretz da orayyta deikre mayim yishretzun veyifkun richasha denefesh chayya meatar dehahi chayya yimshechun lah letatta kema deittemar. veal da amar david (vayyeshev 112 amud bet) (Tehillim 51:12) lev tahor bera li elohim, lemile beorayyta, ucheden veruach nachon chaddesh bekirbi:

Pikkuda shetitaa leitasseka bifriyya ureviyya. dechol man deitassak bifriyya ureviyya, garim (vayyeshev 186 amud bet) lehahu nahar lemehve nevia tadir vela yippaskun memoy. veyamma itmalyay bechol sitrin. (152 1) venishmatin chadtin mitchaddeshan venafkin mehahu ilana. vechelin saggiin itrabbiu leela bahade innun nishmatin. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:20) yishretzu hammayim sheretz nefesh chayya, da berit kayyayma kaddisha nehar denagid venafik, umaya dileh itrabbiu verachashin richasha veribbuya denishmate lehahi chayya.

Uveinnun nishmetin dealin behahi chayya nafke kamma ofe defarchan vetasan kol alma. vechad nishmeta nafka lehay alma hahu ofa defarach venafak bahade hay nishmeta mehahu ilana nafak imeh. kamma nafkan bechol nishmeta venishmeta. (161 2, 21, 41 2) teren, chad mimina vechad missemala. i zache innun natrin leh dichtiv, (Tehillim 91:11) ki malachav yetzavve lach. vei la innun mekatrege aleh. amar ribbi pinchas
24: Telata innun dekayyme appotroppesin ale debar nash kad zache. dichtiv, (Iyov 33:23) im yesh alav malach melitz echad minni alef lehaggid leadam yashro. im yesh alav malach ha chad. melitz tere. echad minni alef lehaggid leadam yashro ha telat.

Amar ribbi shimon, chamesh, dichtiv yattir, vaychunnenu vayyomer. vaychunnennu chad. vayyomer teren. amar leh lav hachi, ella vaychunnennu da kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, deha let reshu leochora ella leh. amar leh shappir ka amart.

Uman deitmena mipperiyya ureviyya kivyachol azir diukena dechalil kol diukenin. vegarim lehahu nahar dela nagdin memoy ufagim keyayma kaddisha bechol sitrin. vealeh ketiv, (Yeshayahu 66:24) veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi. bi vadday da legufa. venishmeteh la ayil lefargoda (demalka) kelal veitrid mehahu alma,

Pikkuda sheviaa lemigzar litmanya yomin uleaavara zuhama dearleta, begin dehahi chayya ihi darga teminaa lechol dargin, vehahi nefesh defarcha minah itztericha leitchazaa kammah litmanya yomin kema deihi (Bereshit 33 1) darga teminaa.

Ucheden itchazze vadday deihi nefesh chayya. nefesh dehahi chayya kaddisha vela missitra ochora. veda ihu yishretzu hammayim. besifra dachanoch yitrashmun maya dezara kaddisha reshimu denefesh chayya. veda reshimu deat yod deitreshim bevisra kaddisha mikkol shear reshumin dealma.

Veof yeofef al haaretz. da eliyyahu detas kol alma bearba tasin lemeheve tamman behahu geziru dikyayma kaddisha. veitzterich letakkena leh kuresayyay uleadkera befumeh da (lecha lecha 93 amud alef) kurseyay deeliyyahu. vei lav la share tamman.

Vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim. teren illen arla uferia. geziru dearla uferia levatar. veinnun dechar venukeva. veet kol nefesh hachayya haromeset, da reshimu deat kayyayma kaddisha deihi nefesh chayya kaddisha kidkaamaran. asher shartzu hammayim mayin illain deitmashchu legabbah deat reshimu da.

Uvegin da itreshimu yisrael birshimu kaddisha vedachyu letatta, kegavvna deinnun reshimin kaddishin, leishtemoda ben setar kaddisha lesitra ochora dimsaavu. uf yisrael reshimin leishtemoda ben (setar) kiddusha, leammin ovde kochavim umazzalot deatyayn missitra ochora dimsaava kema deittemar. uchema derashim lon hachi rashim beire veofe dilhon livire veofe deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael:

Pikkuda teminaa lemircham giyyora (al) deal lemigzar garmeh (yitro 70 amud alef) uleoola techot gadfoy dishchinta. veihi aila lon techot gadfaha leinnun demitparshan missitra ochora mesoova umitkarvin legabbah. dichtiv totze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah.
Vei tema dehay nefesh chayya dichlila beyisrael lecholla hi izdammenat. hadar veamar leminah. kamma akkesadderin veidrin da lego min da it lah lehay eretz deihi chayya techot gadfaha.

Gadfa yemina it lah teren akkesadderin. umehay gaddefa itparshan litrin umin (mishpatim 95 amud alef) ochoranin deinnun kerevin beyichuda (nusach acher baychavesaa) leyisrael leoola lon lego akkesadderin illen. utechot gadfa semala it teren akkesadderin ochoranin umitparshan litren umin ochoranin deinnun ammon umoav. vechulhon ikkerun nefesh chayya.

Vechamma idrin setimin ochoranin vehechalin ochoranin bechol gadfa vegadfa. uminnayyhu nafku ruchin leafrasha (338 lecha 168 amud alef) lechol innun giyyorin demitgayyeyrin. veikrun nefesh chayya, aval leminah. vechullehu alin techot gadfoy dishchinta vela yattir.

Aval nishmeta deyisrael nafka miggo gufa dehahu ilana, umittamman parchin nishmetin lego hay eretz go meaha lego lego. veraza (Malachi 3:12) ki tihyu attem eretz chefetz. veal da yisrael ben yakkir dehamu meaha aleh veikrun (Yeshayahu 46:3) haamusim minni baten vela megaddefin levar. vetu
25: Giyyorin let lon chulaka beilana illaa kol sheken begufa dileh. aval chulaka dilhon begadfin ihu vela yattir. vegiyyora techot gadfe shechinta vela yattir (lecha lecha 96 amud alef) gere hatztzedek innun detamman sharan veitachadan vela lego kema deittemar. uvegin kach totze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah. uleman, behema varemesh vechayto eretz leminah kulhu shaavin nefesh mehahi chayya, aval kol chad leminah kedka chaze lah:
Pikkuda teshiaa lemechan lemiskene ulemehav lon tarpa. dichtiv naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu. naase adam, meshuttafa kelal dechar venukeva. betzalmenu, atire. kidmutenu, miskene.

Deha missitra didchura atire, umissitra denukeva miskene. kema deinnun beshuttefa chada. vechas da al da, veyahiv da leda vegamil leh tivu, hachi itzterich bar nash letatta lemeheve atira umiskena bechibbura chada, ulemehav da leda ulegamlaa tuva da leda.

Veyirdu vidgat hayyam vegomer raza denan chamenan besifra dishlomo malka, dechol man dechas al miskene biruta delibba, la mishtani diukeneh lealam middiyyokna deadam harishon. vechevan dediokna deadam itreshim beh, shallit al kol beriyyayn dealma behahu diukena. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:2) umoraachem vechittechem yihye al kol chayyat haaretz vegomer kulhu zain vedachalin mehahu diukena deitreshim beh, begin deda hu pikkuda maalya leistallaka bar nash bediokneh deadam al kol shear pikkudin.

Mena lan minvuchadnetzar (chayyayva). af al gav dechalam hahu chelma, kol zimna dehava mechan lemiskene la shara aleh chelmeh. kevan deatil ena visha dela lemechan lemiskene, ma ketiv, (Daniel 4:28) od milleta befum malka vegomer, miyyad ishtene diukeneh veatrid min bene nesha. uvegin kach naase adam. ketiv hacha asiya, uchetiv hatam (Rut 2:19) shem haish asher asiti immo hayyom boaz.

Pikkuda asiraa leanacha tefillin uleashlama garmeh bediyyukena illaa. dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo. patach veamar (Shir HaShirim 7:6) roshech alayich kakkarmel hay kera okimna veittemar. aval roshech alayich kakkarmel, da resha illaa tefillin deresha, shema demalka ilaa kaddisha yedovȧ4 beatvavn reshimin, kol at veat parshata chada, shema kaddisha gelifa besiddura deatvavn kedka yeut. utenan (Devarim 28:10) ki shem Adonai nikra alecha veyaru mimmekka, illen tefillin deresha, deinnun shema kaddisha besiddura deatvoy.

Parsheta kadmaa (Shemot 13:2) kaddesh li chol bechor. da 10 deihi kodesh. buchera dechol kudeshin illain. peter kol rechem, behahu shevil dakkik denachat min yod deihu aftach rachama (rachmah) lemebad perin veibbin kedka yaot. veihu kodesh illaa.

Parsheta tinyayna (Shemot 13) vehaya chi yeviacha. da 5 hechala. deitpattach rachama (rachmah) dilah miggo yod bechamshin pitchin akkesadderain veidderin setimin deveh. dehahu peter deavid yod behay hechala lemishma bah kala di nafka miggo shofar da. begin deshofar da hu satim bechol sitrin, veata yod ufetach leh leappaka minneh kala. vechevan deaftach leh taka leh veappik minneh kala leappaka avdin lecheru.

Uvitkiu deshofara da nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim. vechach zammin zimna ochora lesof yomaya. vechol purekana mehay shofar atya. uvegin kach it bah yetziat mitzrayim befarshata da. deha mehay shofar ate bechela deyud defatach rachama dilah veappik kaleh lefurekana deavdin. veda 5 at tinyayna dishma kaddisha.

Parsheta telitaa raza deyichuda (Devarim 6) dishma yisrael. da vav dechalil kolla, uveh yichuda decholla. uveh ityaychadan vehu natil kolla. parsheta reviaa (Devarim 5) vehaya im shamoa, kelilu ditren sitrin
26: Deitachadat behu keneset yisrael gevura diltatta. veda 5 batraa denatla lon veitkelelat minnehon.

Utefillin atvavn dishma kaddisha innun mammash. veal da roshech alayich kakkarmel illen tefillin (ba 43 1, vaetchannan 264 1) deresha). (Shir HaShirim 7:6) vedallat roshech hahi tefilla shel yad deihi miskena legabbe ela uf hachi shelimu it lah kegavvna dilela.

(Shir HaShirim 7:6) melech asur barhatim kashir ihu veachid beinnun batte leitachada behahu shema kaddisha kedka yeut. veal da man deittakkan behu ihu havi betzelem elohim. ma elohim ityachada beh shema kaddisha, af hu ityachad beh shema kaddisha kedka yeut. zachar unekeva bara otam. tefillin deresha utefilla shel yad vechola chad.

Pikkuda chadsar leasra maasra deara. hacha it teren pikkudin. chad leasra maasra deara. vechad bikkure defere ilana. dichtiv (Bereshit 1:29) hinne natati lachem et kol esev zorea zera asher al pene chol haaretz. ketiv hacha hinne natatti. uchetiv hatam (Bamidbar 18:21) velivne levi hinne natatti et kol maaser beyisrael. uchetiv, (Vayikra 27:30) vechol maasar haaretz mizzera haaretz mipperi haetz laAdonai hu.

Pikkuda teresar leayytaa bikkure deilana dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:29) veet kol haetz asher bo peri etz zorea zara. kol man deitchazze li, lechon asira lemechal. attir lon veyahav lon kol maasra dileh uvikkurin deilanin. natatti lachem, lachem velo ledarin devatrechon.

Pikkuda telesar. lemebad purekana livreh lekashra leh bachayyin. ditren memannan ninhu chad dechayyin vechad demota vekayyaymin aleh debar nash, vechad yifrok bar nash livreh, mida dehahu mota parik leh, vela yachil leshaltaa aleh. veraza da vayyar elohim et kol asher asa bichlal. vehinne tov da malach chayyim. meod da malach hammavet. veal da behahu purekana itkayyem da dechayyim veitchallash hahu demavet. befurekana da kane leh chayyim kema deitmmar. vehahu sitra bisha shevak leh vela achid beh:

Pikkuda arbesar lenatra yoma deshabbatta, deihu yoma denayycha mikkol ovade bereshit. hacha kelilan teren pikkudin. chad netira deyom hashshabbat. vechad lekadsha hahu yoma bekiddusheh. lenatra yoma deshabbatta kema deadkarna veatarna alayyhu deihu yoma denayycha lealmin. vechol avidan beh ishtachlelu veitavidu ad deitkaddash yoma.

Kevan deitkaddash yoma ishtaar beria deruchin dela itbere lon gufa. vechi la hava yada kudesha berich hu leakava lekaddesha yoma ad deyitberun gufin lehani ruchin. ela ilana dedaat tov vera atar hahu sitra ochora dera uvaa leittakkefa bealma veitparshu kamma ruchin bechamma zayynin leittakkefa bealma begufin.

Kevan dechama kudesha berich hu kach, atar miggo ilana dechayye neshiva derucha uvatash beilana ochora veatar sitra ochora detov veitkaddash yoma. deha beriu degufin veitaru deruchin besitra detov ihu behay lelya, vela besitra ochora.

Veilmale akdim sitra ochora behay lelya ad dela yakdim sitra detov, la yachil alma lemekam kammayyhu afillu riga chada. aval asvavta akdim kudesha berich hu dedalig kammeh kiddusha deyoma veakdim kamme sitra ochora veitkeyyaym alma. uma dechashiv sitra ochora leitbene bealma leittakkefa, itbene behay lelya sitra detov veittakkaf veitbenun gufin veruchin kaddishin behay lelya missitra detov. uvegin kach onatan dechakkimin deyade da mishshabbat
27: Deha keden chamat da sitra ochora dechamma deihi chashivat lemebad, avide (avid) sitra dikdusha. azla umeshatteta bechamma chayyaylin vesitrin dilah vechamat kol innun deka meshamshe arsayyhu begilluya degufehon linhora devutzina, vechol innun benin denafkin mittamman havu nichfin desharu alayyhu ruchin mehahu sitra ochora. veinnun ruchin artilain dechayyayvaya deikrun mazzikin veshariat behu lilit uketilat lon.

Kevan deitkaddash yoma veshalta kedusha al alma, hahu sitra ochora azirat garmah veittamrat kol lelya deshabbatta veyoma deshabbatta, bar min asimon vechol kat dileh deazle al sheragge bitmiru lemechome al gilluye deshimmusha, ulevatar ittammerun go nukeva dithoma rabba. kevan denafak shabbatta, kamma chayyaylin umashshiryayn parchin umeshattetin bealma, veal da itkan shir shel pegaim dela yishletun al amma kaddisha.

Lean atar meshattete behahu lelya. kad nafke bivhilu vechashvin leshalletaa bealma al amma kaddisha vechaman lon bitzlota veamrin shirata da, uvesheruta mavdele bitzlota umavdele al hakkos, parche mittamman veazle umeshatte umatan lego madbera. rachamana leshezvan minnayyhu umisitran (umissitra) bisha.

Amru rabbotenu zichrono livracha telata innun garmin bisha legarmayyhu. chad man delayyit garmeh. tinyayna man dezarak nahama o perurin deit behu kazzayit. telitaa man deokid sheragga bemifka deshabbatta ad la matu yisrael lekiddusha desidra degarim lenura degehinnom leadlaka behay nura ad la mata zimnayyhu.

Dechad ducheta it baggihinnam leinnun deka mechallele shabbatot, veinnun daanushin bagehinnom layytin leh lehahu deokid sheragga ad la mata zimneh, veamri leh (Yeshayahu 22:17) hinne Adonai metaltelcha taltela gaver vegomer (Yeshayahu 22:18) tzanof yitznafcha tzenefa kaddur el eretz rachavat yadayim.

Begin delav yaot hu leadlaka nura kad nafik shabbatta ad demavdele yisrael bitzlota umavdele al kassa. begin dead hahu zimna shabbat hu, ukedusha deshabbat shalit alana. uveshaata demavdilin al kassa kol innun chayyaylin vechol innun mashshiryayn deitmenan al yome dechol, kol chad vechad yativ leatreh ufulechaneh deitmene aleh.

Begin dechad al shabbatta veitkaddash yoma, kodesh itar veshallit bealma, vechol itadde mishshuletanuta dileh, ad shaata denafik shabbatta la tayyvin leatrayyhu. veaf al gav denafik shabbatta la tayyvin leatrayyhu ad zimna deamre yisrael baruch atta Adonai hammavdil ben kodesh lechol. keden kodesh istallak, umashshiryayn deitmaniu al yome dechol mitarin vetayyvin leatrayyhu kol chad vechad al matreh deitpekad aleh.

Veim kol da la shaltin ad dihon nehorin meraza dishraga. vechulhon ikrun meore haesh begin (damenahevarea denura denagda) (nusach acher damerazea deammuda denura) umisoda denura atyan kulhu veshaltin al alma tattaa. vechol da kad bar nash adlik sheragga ad la shelimu yisrael kiddusha desidra.

Aval i ihu mamtin ad deyashlimu kiddusha desidra, innun chayyayvin degehinnom matzdikin alayyhu dina dekudesha berich hu, veinnun mekayyeyme al hahu bar nash kol birchan deka amre tzibbura (Bereshit 27:28) veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim (Devarim 28:3) baruch atta bair uvaruch atta bassade vegomer. (Tehillim 41:2) ashre maskil el dal beyom raa yemaltehu Adonai. beyom ra mibbae leh, may beyom raa. yoma deshalta hahi raa lemesav nishmeteh.

Ashre maskil el dal da hu shechiv mera leassaa leh mechovoy gabbe kudesha berich hu. davar achar da yoma dedina sharya al alma ishteziv minneh kema deittemar beyom raa yemaltehu Adonai. yoma deitmasar dina lehahu raa leshaltaa al alma (chaser):
28: (Nusach acher Bereshit bechachmeta demalka galif vakev) huremnuta demalka, galif gelufe (nusach acher galeypev) bithiru illaa butzina dekardinuta, venafik go satim distimu merisha (nusach acher meraza) deen sof kutera (perush ashan) begulema, naitz beizka la chivvavr vela ucham vela sumak vela yarok vla gon kelal, kad (nusach acher hadar) madid meshicha avid gonin leanhara, lego bego botzina nafik (nusach acher venafik) chad neviu deminneh itztabbeu gonin letatta.

Satim go setimin deraza deen sof baka vela baka avira dileh la ityeyda kelal, ad demiggo dechiku divkiuteh nahir (20 1) nekuda chada setima illaa, batar hahi nekuda la ityeyda kelal, uvegin kach ikre reshit maamar kadmaa decholla:

(Daniel 12:3) vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia umatzdike harabbim kakkochavim leolam vaed. zohar setima distimin, batash avira dileh (demate velo mate) (nusach acher veanhir) behay nekuda (sefer acher nehora) ucheden itpashat hay reshit veavid leh hechala likareh uletushebachteh (yikkare lehechleh valetaveshabechatea). (nusach acher valeykerayh valehaykaleyh valetaveshabechateyh). tamman zara zara dekudesha leolada letoalta dealma, veraza da (Yeshayahu 6:13) zera kodesh matztzavtah.

Zohar dezara zara likareh, kehay zara demeshi deargevavn tav deitchafe lego veavid leh hechala deihu tushebachta dileh vetoalta decholla. behay reshit bera hahu setima dela ityeyda lehechala da. hechala da ikre elohim, veraza da bereshit bara elohim.
Zohar deminneh kulhu maamarot itberiu beraza deitpashtuta dinkuda dezohar satim da. i behay ketiv bara, let tevavha dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo,

Zohar raza da bereshit kadmaa dechola shemeh ehye shema kaddisha gelifa besitroy (nusach acher nahir 57 bagelapea nahir) elohim. gelifa beitra (nusach acher begillufa daayteraa) asher hechala tamir veganiz, sheriuta deraza dereshit. asher rosh denafik mereshit.
29: Ittakkan levatar nekuda vehechala (basedarea) (kesidra) kechada, keden bereshit kalil (reshit) reshita illaa bechachmeta. levatar itchallaf gavvavn hahu hechala veikre bayit. (nusach acher vameyneyh itchaddash hechala) nekuda illaa ikre rosh. kalil da beda beraza bereshit, kad ihu kolla kechada bichlala chada ad la have yishshuva beveta, kevan deizdera letikkuna deyishshuva keden ikre elohim temira setima:

Zohar satim veganiz kad benin (sefer acher ad divnin) begavveh leolada uveta kayyayma bifshitu detikkuna deinnun zera kodesh. vead la itadiat vela itpashshat peshitu deyishshuva la ikre elohim, ella kolla bichlala bereshit, levatar deittakkan bishma (balak 202) deelohim appik innun toladin mehahu zara deizdera beh. man hahu zara, innun atvavn gelifan raza deorayyta denafku mehahi nekuda.

Hahi nekuda zara bego hahu hechala raza (nusach acher zara) ditlat nekudin cholam, shuruk, chirik. veitkelilu da beda veitavidu raza chada. kol denafik bechibbura chada. beshaata denafak, nafkat bat zugeh bahadeh dechalil kol atvavn. dichtiv et hashshamayim, kol uvat zugo. hay kol deihu shamayim ihu eheye batraa. zohar dechalil kol atvavn ugevavnin, kegavvna (nusach acher zara) da.

Ad hacha Adonai elohenu Adonai, illen telata dargin lokovel raza da illaa bereshit bara elohim. bereshit raza kadmaa. bara raza setima leitpashta mittamman kolla. elohim raza lekayyayma kolla letatta. et hashshamayim, dela leafrasha lon dechar venukeva kechada.

Et kad natil atvavn kulhon kelala (pikkude 234) dechulhu atvavn innun resha vesofa. levatar ittosaf hei leitchabbera kulhu atvavn beHei veitkere atta. veal da (Nechemya 9:6) veatta mechayye et kullam. (28 1) et raza adonay vehachi ikre. hashshamayim da Adonai raza illaa.

Veet tikkuna dechar venukeva. veet raza vAdonai, vecholla chad. haaretz da elohim kegavvna illaa lemebad perin veibbin. shema da kelila bitlat duchete, umittamman itperash shema da lechamma sitrin. ad hacha raza desitra desitrin degaled uvane vekiyyem beorach satim besitra dechad kera.

Mikkan ulehala bereshit, bara shit, miktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim, shit sitrin demitpashtan meraza ilaa beitpashtuta (nusach acher mishshalosh nekudot) devara miggo nekuda kadmaa. bara itpashtuta dechad (nusach acher miggo) nekuda dilela. vehacha aglif raza shema dearbein uteren atvavn:

(Daniel 12:3) vehammaskilim yazhiru, kegavvna dittenue (nusach acher dateamey) dimnagne, uvenigguna dilhon azlin abbatrayyhu atvavn venikkude, umitnanean abbatrayyhu kechayyaylin batar malchehon. (tikkunim 24) gufa atvavn, verucha nekude. kulhu netalu bematlanehon batar tenue (nusach acher taame) vekayyme bekiyyomayyhu. kad nigguna detaame natil, natle atvavn venikkude abbatrayyhu. kad ihu pasik innun la natlin vekayyme bekiyyumayyhu.

Vehammaskilim yazhiru, atvavn venikkude. kezohar nigguna detaame. harakia itpashtuta denigguna kegon innun demitpashte bifshitu veazlu benigguna. umatzdike harabbim innun pissuke detaame defaske bematlanehon divgin kach ishtema milla. yazhiru atvavn venikkude venaharin kechada bematlanin (bametalenayhaven) beraza distimu bematlanuta (nusach acher beinnun) keinnun shevilin setimin. mehay itpashshat kolla. vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia innun kayyaymin vesamchin dehahu appiryon. hammaskilim innun kayyaymin vesamchin ilain deinnun mistakkele besuchletanu bechol ma deitzterich hahu (29 1) appiryon vesamchin (nusach acher deveh) dileh. sitra da kema deat amer, (Tehillim 41:2) ashre maskil el dal. yazhiru, dei la yazhiru vela naharin la yachlin leayyna uleistakkala behahu appiryon bechol ma deitzterich.
30: Al gabbe innun maskilim dichtiv beh (Yechezkel 1:22) udemut al rashe hachayya rakia keen hakkerach hannora. zohar dehahu (dehu) nahir leorayyta. zohar denahir leinnun rashe dehahi chaya, veinnun rashe innun maskilim denaharin tadir umistakkelan lehahu rakia lehahu nehiru denafik mittamman, veda ihu nehiru deorayyta denahir taddir vela pasik.

Vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu vegomer, hayta (39 2) dayyka mikkadmat dena, talga go mayay. nafka minnah zuhama behahu chela detalga bemayyay, veakkish bah esha takkifa vehava bah pesolet, veitadiat veitavidat tohu meatar (nusach acher madora) dezuhama. kina difsolet. vavohu beriru deitberir miggo pesolet veityayshav bah choshech, raza deesha takkifa. vehahu chshech dechafe (chafe) al gabbe hahu tohu al gabbe hahu pesolet veittakkanat mineh.

Veruach elohim, ruach kudesha denafik meelohim chayyim veda merachefet al pene hammayim. batar dehay ruach nashiv ivrir dekiku chad miggo hahu pesolet ketisa dezuhama. kad ivrir veatznif veatzrif zimna uteren ad deyishtaar hahu zuhama delet beh zuhama kelal,

Kad hay tohu ivrir veatzrif nafak mineh (Melachim 1 19:11) ruach gedola vechazak mefarek harim umeshabber selaim (96 30 amud alef) hahu dechama eliyyahu. ivrir behu veatzrif venafak mineh raash dichtiv, (Melachim 1 19:11) veachar haruach raash. veivrir choshech veachlil beraza dileh esh dichtiv veachar haraash esh. ivrir ruach veitkelil beraza dileh (yitro 81 2 vetikun 38) kol demama dakka.

Tohu atar delet beh gon velo diyyokna vela itkelil beraza dediyyokna. hasheta ihu bediyyukena kad mistakkelan beh let leh diyyokna kelal. lecholla it levusha leitlabbesha bar hay. (deitchaze beh veleteh kelal velo have).

Bohu lehay it leh tziyyura vediyyukena avnin meshakin go gelifa (nusach acher kelippa) detohu nafke go gelifa dimshakan tamman. umittamman mashche toalta lealma betziyyura dilvusha, mashche toalta meela letatta vesalka mittatta leela.

Veal da nekuvin umefulamin, hanne talyayn baavira. lezimnin talyayn baavira desalke mittamman leela. lezimnin mittamrin beyoma deibba umefike mayin miggo tehoma leitzena tohu mittamman deha keden chedva ushetuta (nusach acher veshaata) deka (nusach acher dela) itpashat tohu bealma.

Choshecha hu esha uchema takkif begon. esha sumeka takkif bechezu. esha yeruka takkif betziyyur. (pikkude 243 uteruma 128) esha chivavra gon dechalil kolla. choshech takkif bechol eshin veda atkif letohu. choshech hu esha velav ihu esha chashocha bar kad atkif letohu, veraza da (Bereshit 27:1) vattichhena enav merot vayyikra et esav vegomer. choshech pene ra deasbar anpin lera, ucheden ikre choshech deshare aleh leittakfa leh. veraza da vechoshech al pene tehom.

Ruach hu kol deshare al bohu veatkif leh veanhig leh bechol ma deitzterich. veraza da (Tehillim 29:3) kol Adonai al hammayim. vechen ruach elohim merachefet al pene hammayim. avnin meshakan go tehome denafke mayyay minhon. veal da ikrun peni hammayim. ruach anhig veatkif leinnun panim pene tehom, da kema deitzterich leh veda kema deitzterich leh.
Tohu aleh sharya shem 314. bohu aleh sharya shem tzevaot. choshech aleh sharya shem elohim. ruach aleh sharya shem Adonai.

Ruach chazak mefarek harim lo baruach Adonai vegomer shema da la have beh, deha 314 shalta aleh beraza (dasetarea) detohu. veachar haruach raash lo baraash Adonai deha shem tzevaot shalta beh beraza devohu. veal da ikre bohu raash delav ihu bela raash.

Veachar haraash esh lo baesh Adonai deha shema deelohim shalta beh missitra dechoshech. veachar haesh kol demama dakka hacha ishtechach shem Adonai. arba pirkin hacha deinnun pirke gufa veevrin yedian deinnun arbaa veinnun terisar vehacha shema gelifa ditresar atvavn deitmasar leeliyyahu bamara (45 shanedapes kan bidfus manetavebah kareymevaneh lavebaleyn uchetiv appiryon vechulei ad setimin dela itgalleyayn, lefanenu hu lekamman baddaf 29 amud alef vedaf 30 av)
31: , (Bereshit 1:3) vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or. mehacha ihu sheruta leashkacha genizin hech itbere alma bifrat. dead hacha hava bichlal. uvatar ithaddar kelal. lemehve kelal uferat uchelal.

Ad hacha hava kolla talyay baavira meraza deen sof, kevan deitpeshat chela behechala illaa raza deelohim, ketiv beh amira (dichtiv) vayyomer elohim. deha leela la ketiv beh amira bifrat. veaf al gav divrishit maamar hu, aval la ketiv beh vayyomer.

Da vayyomer ihu kayyeyma lemishal uleminda. vayyomer chela deitram vearamuta bachashay (vaychi 234 2) meraza deen sof beraza (nusach acher beresha) demachashava. vayyomer elohim hasheta (leel 15 amud bet) olid hahu hechala mimma deitadiat mizzara dekodesh, veolid bachashay. vehahu deityelad (deityeylid) ishtema levar. man deolid leh olid bachashay dela ishtema kelal, kevan denafak minneh, man denafak, itavid kol deishtema levar.
Yehi or. kol ma denafak beraza da nafak. (ralebab) yehi al raza deabba veima deihu 15. ulevatar ithaddar linkuda kadmaa, lemeheve sheruta leitpashsheta lemilla ochora or.

Vayhi or, or dichvar hava. or da raza setima itpashtuta deitpeshat veitbeka meraza desitra deavir illaa setima. baka bekadmita veappik chad nekuda setima meraza dileh. deha en sof baka meavira dileh vegale hay nekuda 10. kevan dehay 10 itpeshat, ma deishtaar ishtechach or mehahu raza dehahu avir setimaa.

Kad ishtechach minneh nekuda kadmaa 10, itgeli levatar aleh (58 65 amud alef) mate vela mate. kevan deitpeshat nafak veihu hu or deishtaar meavir. vehayenu or dichvar hava, veha kayyayma. nafak veistallak veitgeniz veishtaar chad nekuda minneh lemehve mate tadir beorach genizu behahi nekuda mate vela mate. nahir beh beorach nekuda kadmaa denafak minneh. uvegin chach kolla achid da beda. nahir behay uvehay.

Kad salik kolla salkin veitachadan beh veihu mate veigniz beatar deen sof vecholla chad itavid. hahu nekuda deor, or ihu. veitpeshat unehiru beh sheva atvavn dealfa beta vela akrishu velachim havu. nafak choshech levatar venafku beh sheva atvavn ochoran dealfa beta vela akrishu vekayymu lachim. nafak rakia deafrish machloket ditren sitrin venafku beh temanya atvavn ochoranin. keden 22. dalgu sheva atvavn dehay sitra vesheva dehay sitra, veitgelifu kulhu behahu rakia vehavu kayyme lachim. akresh hahu raki veakrishu atvavn veiglimu veittzayyru betziyyurayyhu. veaglif tamman orayyta leanhara levar.

Yehi or dehu el gadol raza denafik meavir kadmaa. vayhi raza dechoshech deikre elohim or deitkelil semala beyamina. ucheden meraza deel have elohim, itkelil yamina bismala (31 amud alef) usemala beyamina

Vayyar elohim et haor ki tov da ammuda deemtzaita ki tov anhir ela vetatta ulechol shear sitrin beraza Adonai shema deachid lechol sitrin. vayyavdel elohim vegomer afrish machloket lemeheve kolla shelim.

Vayyikra elohim vegomer, mahu vayyikra, kera vezammin leappaka mehay or shelim dekayyma beemtzaita, chad nehiru deihu yesoda dealma dealeh kayyamin almin. umehahu or shelim ammuda deemtzaita itpeshat yesoda chay almin deihu yom missitra deyamina. velachoshech kara layla, kera vezammin veappik missitra dechoshech chad nukeva sihara deshalta belelya veikre layla raza dedny adon kol haaretz.
Al yamina behahu ammuda shelim debemtzaita kalil beraza dismala, vesalik leela ad nekuda kadmaa venatil veachid
32: Tamman milla (nusach acher chela) ditlat nekudin cholam shuruk chirik zera kodesh. deha let zara deizdera bar beraza da, veitchabbar kolla beammuda deemtzaita. veappik yesoda dealma, uvegin kach ikre kol deachid lecholla binhiru detiuveta.

Semala lahit betokpa vearach, bechuleho dargin arach recha. umehahu lehitu deesha appik hahi nukeva sihara. vehahu lehitu hava choshech begin dehava mechoshech. uteren sitrin illen appiku teren dargin illen chad dechar vechad nukeva.

Yesoda achid beammuda deemtzaita mehahu tosefet nehora dehava beh, dechevan dehahu ammuda deemtzaita ishtelim veavid shelam lechol sitrin, keden ittosaf beh nehiru meela umikkol sitrin bechedva decholla beh. umehahu tosefet dechedva nafik yesoda dealmin veikre musaf. mehacha nafkin kol chayyaylin letatta veruchin venishmatin kaddishin beraza Adonai tzevaot, el elohe haruchot.

Layla adon kol haaretz, missitra dismala mehahu choshech. uvegin dehahu choshech tiuveteh leitkelala beyamina vechalash tukefeh, itpeshat minneh hay layla. kad share lehitpashta hay layla ad la istayyaym, hahu choshech al veitkelil beyamina veyamina achid leh, veishtaar bigriu hay layla.

Uchema dechoshech tiuveteh leitkelala beor hachi layla tiuveteh leitkelala beyyom. choshech gara nehoreh, uvegin kach appik darga bigriu vela binhiru. choshech la nahir ella kad itkelil beor. layla denafak minneh la nahir ella kad itkelil beyyom. geriu delayla la ishtelim ella bemusaf. ma deittosaf hacha gara hacha.

Bemusaf hava beh raza dinkuda illaa veraza deammuda deemtzaita bechol sitrin, uvegin kach ittosaf beh teren atvavn. belelya geriu beh illen teren. keden kara ketiv vayyikra vegara minneh (22) (16) uchetiv kara layla. hacha raza dishma deshivin uteren atvavn gelifa dechitra illaa:

Vayyomer elohim yehi rakia betoch hammayim vegomer, hacha bifrat raza leafrasha (ben) (teruma 149 amud bet) mayin ilain letattae (latetaayn) beraza dismala. (nusach acher vaataberay) hacha machloket beraza dismala. dead hacha raza deyamina hu, vehacha hu raza dismala, uvegin kach asgiu machloket (nusach acher ben) begin da leyamina. yamina ihu shelema decholla, uvegin kach beyamina ketiv kolla deha beh talyay kol shelimu. kad itar semala itar machloket. uvehahu machloket ittakkaf esha derugeza venafik minneh mehahu machloket gehinnom. vegehinnom bismala itar veitdabbak.

Chachmeta demoshe beha istakkal uveovada divreshit ashgach. beovada divrishit hava machloket semala beyamina, uvehahu machloket deitar beh semala nafak beh gehinnom veitdevak beh. ammuda deemtzaita deihu yom telitay al benayyhu veafrish machloket veaskim litren sitrin. vegehinnom nachit letatta. usemala itkelil beyamina vehava shelama becholla.

Kegavvna da machloket korach beaharon semala beyamina. istakkal moshe beovada divreshit. amar li itchazze leafrasha machloket ben yamina lismala. ishtaddal leaskama benayyhu. vela bae semala veatkaf korach betukefeh.

Amar vadday gehinnom betukefa demachloket semala itzterich leitdabbeka (sefer acher leella uleitkallela bimina) hu la bae leitdabbeka leela uleitkallela beyamina, vadday yechot letatta betukefa derugeza dileh.

Veal da la bae korach leaskama hay machloket bida demoshe begin dela hava (33 amud alef) leshem shamayim vela chayish likara dilela veakkechish ovada divreshit. kevan dechama moshe dehava makkechish ovada divreshit veitdecha ihu levar, keden vayyichar lemoshe meod.
Vayyichar lemoshe al deakkechishu leh dela askim hahu machloket. meod al deakkechishu ovada divreshit. uvecholla akkechish
33: Korach beela uvetatta. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 26:9) behatztzotam al Adonai, ha tatta veela. veal da itdabbak kema (bema) deitchazze leh.

Machloket deittakkan kegavvna dilela vesalik vela nachit veitkeyyaym beorach meshar, da machloket deshshammay vehillel. vekudesha berich hu afrish benayyhu veaskim lon. veda hava machloket leshem shamayim. veshamayim afrish machloket. veal da itkeyyaym (alma). veda hava kegavvna deovada divreshit. vekorach beovada divreshit akkechish becholla. ufelugeta deshamayim hava. uvea leakkechasha mille deorayyta. vadday beitdabbekuta degihinnom hava. veal da itdabbak bahadeh.

Veraza da besifra deadam. choshech kad itar itar betukepeh uvera beh gehinnom veitdabbak bahadeh behahu machloket. kevan deshachich rugeza vetukepa, itar machloket kegavvna ochora, machloket dirchimu.

Uteren machloket havu. chad sheruta vechad siyyuma. veda ihu archehon detzaddikayyay sheruta dilhon bekashyu vesofa dilhon binyaycha. korach hava sheruta demachloket kefum rugeza vetukepa veitdabbak baggehinnam. shammay sofa demachloket kad rugeza binyaycha itzterich leatara machloket dirchimu uleaskama al yeda deshamayim.

Veraza da yehi rakia betoch hammayim vihi mavdil, da machloket kadmaa itaru derugeza vetukepa baa leafrasha veitar gehinnom ad derugeza vetukepa itztannan. ucheden vayyaas elohim et harakia vegomer itar machloket dirchimu vechavivu vekiyyuma dealma. uveraza da machloket shammay vehillel. detora shebbaal pe alat birchimu gabbe tora shebbichtav vehavu bekiyyuma shelim.

Havedala ihu vadday bismala. ketiv hacha havedala, vihi mavdil uchetiv vayyavdel, uchetiv hatam (Bamidbar 16:9) hameat mikkem ki hivdil vegomer, uchetiv (Devarim 6) baet hahi hivdil Adonai et shevet hallevi. deha vadday let havedala ella bashsheni beatar semala.

Vei tema havedala bashsheni ihu vadday ammay havedala belevi deihu telitaa. havedala beshimon itzterich deihu sheni. ella, af al gav delevi ihu telitaa. ledata deyaakov sheni hava. uleolam bashsheni hava, vecholla beorach meshar beorach shelim kedka yeut.

Havedala bemotzae shabbat ben innun deshallitin beyome chol leshabbat. vechad nafik shabbat salka miggehinnom chad sitra meena bisha (sefer acher taseyrea memana bisha) devaa leshaltaa beshaata deamrin yisrael (Tehillim 90:17) umaase yadenu konna alenu venafik mehahu darga deikre semala (nusach acher sheula) uvae leitarva bezara deyisrael uleshaltaa alayyhu yisrael.

Veyisrael avde ovada behadas uveyayin veamre havedala, veitperash minnayyhu, umaich hahu sitra veal leducheteh bashsheol atar dekorach vesiateh tamman dichtiv, (Bamidbar 19) vayyerdu hem vechol asher lahem chayyim sheola. veinnun la nachte tamman ad deavde yisrael havedala minhon dichtiv, (Bamidbar 19) hibbadlu mittoch haeda vegomer.

Uleolam havedala bashsheni deihu semala besheruta vetukepa verugeza deitar semala bemachloket ad la shachich binyaycha veitbere beh gehinnom. (18 2) keden itberiu kol innun malachim dekatrege lemarehon leela veachil lon nura veittokdu. vechen kol shear innun demitbattele velet lon kiyyuma veitachalu benura. kegavvna da korach letatta. vechola kegavvna da.

Yehi rakia itpashshat peshitu da min da. 31 kitfa yamina el gadol itpeshat peshitu min go mayay leishtallama shema da el uleitkallala behahu peshitu da beda, veitpashshat meel elohim 55 illen itpashshatu veithappachu lemehve mayin tattain 55 hahu peshitu deitpashshat bashsheni, mayin illain 55 ze hayyam gadol. 55 mayin illain, hippucha deillen atvavn 55 mayin tattain. kevan deittakkenu itavidu kolla kelala chada veitpashshat shema da bechamma duchete.

Mayin illain dechurin. umayin tattain nukeve. bekadmita havu mayim bemayim, ad deitperashu leishtemoda mayin illain vetattain, da elohim (nusach acher mayin illain). veda 65 (nusach acher mayin tattain). veda Adonai illaa vaAdonai tattaa. ma ketiv vayyaas elohim et harakia. itpashtuta da natal shema da elohim mayin illain. umayin
34: Tattain 65. veim kol da kevan deishtellimu mayin dechurin bemayin nukevin, shema delohim itpashshat becholla.

Veaf al gav deafrish ben mayin illain letattain, machloket la itbattal ad yom telitae veaskim machloket veityashshav kolla beducheteh kedka yeut. uvegin machloket da af al pi deihu kiyyuma dealma la ketiv ki tov bashsheni, dela ishtelim ovada. mayin illain umayin tattain havu kechada vela havu toladin bealma ad deitperashu veishtemodau. uvegin kach avdu toladin.

Veim kol da af al gav dehavdala have bashsheni umachloket beh hava, yom telitae askim becholla dehu shema deiglaf biglifoy (sefer acher Adonai) hava leistakkema mayyin illain umayin tattain Adonai illaa, Adonai tattaa, 6 benayyhu. leashlama bitren sitrin. vesimana da me hayyarden mayin illain kamu ned echad. mayin tattain nachatu leyamma. veyisrael azle beemtzaita.

Chamesh rekiin ketive hacha vechay haolamim azil behu veanhig behu vechulhu kelilan da beda. veilmale hay machloket deistakkam al yede deemtzaita la itkelilu vela ishtayyru (nusach acher ateyysharev). chamesh mea shenin innun deilana dechayye davik behu lemebad ibbin vetoladin lealma vechol memoy divreshit denagdin veitmashchan mibberishit itpalgu techotoy al yedeh. vedavid malka nakit kolla veihu palig levatar dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 6:19) vaychallek lechol haam lechol hamon vegomer uchetiv, (Tehillim 104:28) titten lahem yilkotun uchetiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref vegomer.

Beshaata deitar machloket betukepa dismala, asge veatkef horfila detifsa venafku mittamman tesirin veakrishu miyyad bela lachuta kelal vehavu dechar venukeva. uminhon itperashu zayynin bishin liznayyhu, vehacha takkifu deruach mesoova bechol innun tukefin tesirin. veinnun raza dearla. ilen ittakfu bezayynin takkifin, chad efe vechad nachash vetarvavyyhu chad. efe olid (sefer acher leshivin) leshiva shenin bechibbura chada, ithaddar kolla lesheva shenin denachash.

Hacha ihu raza degehinnom deikre bishva shemahan. yetzer hara bishva shemahan ikre. uvechamma dargin itpashshat mesaavu mehacha lealma vecholla meraza dismala, tav uvish veihu yishshuva dealma. hacha shema gelifa ditmanne sare atvavn memanna al gishme ratzon nedava uveracha yishshuva dealma:

(600 Adonai) vayyomer elokim yikkavu hammayim vegomer beorach kav lemeheve beorach meshar. deha meraza dehahi nekuda kadmaa nafak kolla bistimu. ad demate veitkannish lehechala illaa umittamman nafik bekav meshar lishar dargin. ad demate lehahu atar chad dechanish kolla bichlal dechar venukeva. uman ihu chay almin.

Hammayim denafke milel meet Adonai illaa. mittachat hashshamayim 6 zeera. veal da 12 chad shamayim vechad mittachat hashshamayim. keden veterae hayyabbasha da Adonai tattaa. da itgeli. vechol shear itkasse. umiggo hay batraa ishtema besucheltanu hahu deitkasse.

El makom echad begin dehacha hu kishshura deyichuda dealma illaa Adonai echad ushemo echad (teruma 134 amud alef) teren yichudin chad dealma illaa leityachada bedargoy, vechad dealma tattaa leityachada bedargoy. kishshura deyichuda dealma illaa ad hacha ihu. chay almin tamman itbesim veitkashshar alma illaa beyichuda dileh. uvegin kach ikre makom echad. kol dargin vechol shayyfin mitkanshin tamman vehavu kulhu beh chad bela piruda kelal. velet darga deityachadan tamman beyichuda chad ela hay, uveh itkasseyayn kulhu beorach satim betiuveta chad. ad hacha bedarga da ityaychad alma deitgalyay bealma deitkasyay.

Alma deitgalyay ityaychad uf hachi letatta, vealma deitgalyay ihu alma detattaa. (yeshaya 6) vaere et Adonai (Shemot 24:10) vayyiru et elohe yisrael (Bamidbar 14:10) uchevod Adonai nira (Bamidbar 17:7) vayyera chevod Adonai (Yechezkel 1:28) kemare hakkeshet vegomer ken mare hannoga saviv hu mare demut kevod Adonai. veda ihu raza veterae hayyabbasha.
(Yechezkel 1:28) kemare hakkeshet ze chay almin. vezehu et kashti natatti beanan da malchut. natatti min yoma deitbere alma. beyoma
35: Deibba deitchazze keshet (deittear semala leittakkefa). mare demut kevod Adonai itar semala leittakkefa. nafkat rachel vattekash belidtah. michael besitra da, refael besitra da, gavriel besitra da. veinnun gevavnin deitchazzeyayn behahu demut chivar vesumak veyarok.
Ken mare hannoga saviv. nehiru deitkasyay begilgula dechezu deena. hu mare demut kevod Adonai. gevavnin deityachada yichuda tattaa lefum yichuda deityachad yichuda dilela.

Adonai elohenu Adonai. gevavnin setimin dela itchazan veitkashsheran el makom echad yichuda chada beillaa. gevavnin bakkeshet letatta leityachada behu. chivvavr somak veyarok kigvavnin setimin. veinnun yichuda ochora raza ushemo echad. baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed yichuda diltatta. yichuda illaa (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. da lokovel da.

Yikkavu medidu dekav umishchata. hacha shit tevin. vehacha shit tevin. mishchata botzina dekardinuta dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:12) mi madad beshoolo mayim. veda ihu yikkavu hammayim. hacha shiura deyotzer almin (Bereshit 23 amud alef) yod hei vav hei,
Kadosh kadosh kadosh da ihu yikkavu hammayim. Adonai tzevaot. da ihu el makom echad beraza dishma da. melo chol haaretz kevodo. da veterae hayyabbasha. raza gelifa shema deyichuda 39 135 39.

Tadshe haaretz deshe esev vegomer hasheta appikat chela beinnun mayyin deitkenashu leatar chad venagdin begavevy go temiru setimaa. venafkin begavveh temirin illain vechayyaylin kaddishin. di kol innun bene mehemnuta metaknan lon betikkuna dimhemnuta behahi pulechana demarehon.

Veraza da (Tehillim 104:14) matzmiach chatzir labbehema vegomer da behema dirviaa al elef turin umegaddelin lah bechol yoma hahu chatzir. vechatzir da innun malachin shallitin lefum shaata deitberiu bashsheni vekayyaymin lemechala dehay behema. begin deit esha echla esha.

Veesev laavodat haadam esev da illen ofannin vechayyot ucheruvim. dechulhu metaknan go tikkunayyhu vekayyaymin leittakna beshaata divne nesha atyayn lefulechana demarehon bekarbenehon uvitzlota deda ihu avodat haadam. veesev da izdamman veitattad laavodat haadam leittakkena betikkuneh kedka yeut.

Vechad innun mittaknan behahi avodat haadam, levatar minnayyhu nafke mezone vetarpin lealma dichtiv (Tehillim 104:14) lehotzi lechem min haaretz. veda ihu esev mazria zera, deha chatzir la mazria zera ihu ella izdamman lemechla deesha kaddisha. veesev letikkuna dealma.

Vechol da lehotzi lechem min haaretz. kol tikkunin divne nesha deka metakkena lehay esev eretz. defulechana dilhon lemarehon lesappeka al yedehon mehahi eretz tarpe umezoni lehay alma uleitbarcha bene nesha mibbirchan dilel (dilella).

Etz peri ose peri. darga al darga dechar venukeva. (Bereshit 33 amud alef) kema deetz peri appik chela deetz ose peri, uf hacha appik ihu. uman ihu illen innun keruvim vetimrot. may timrot. illen innun desalke bitnana dekarbana, umittakkene bahadeh veakman (nusach acher veikrun) timrot ashan. vechulhu kayyaymin betikkunayyhu laavodat haadam, ma dela kayyma ken chatzir deha itattad lemechal dichtiv, (Iyov 40:15) hinne na behemot asher asiti immach chatzir kevakar yochal.

Etz peri ose peri diukena dechar venukeva. udemut penehem pene adam. illen lav innun keinnun keruvim. illen appe ravrevan bedikna chatima. keruvim appe zutere keravyayn. peni adam kol (din) diukenin kelilan behu. begin deinnun appin ravrevin umitztayyrin behu tziyyurin gelifin kegillufe shema meforash bearba sitre dealma mizrach maarav tzafon vedarom.

Michael rashim reshimu letzad darom. vechol anpin mistakkelin legabbeh. pene adam pene arye pene shor peni nesher. adam ihu dechar venukeva, vela ikre adam bar hani uminneh itztayyran tziyyurin derechev elohim ribbotayim dichtiv, (Tehillim 68:18) rechev elohim ribbotayim alfe shinan.
Shinan kelala dechulhu tziyyurin shor nesher arye. 50 da ihu adam
36: Peshitu deitkelil kechada (ekev raad amud alef) beraza dechar venukeva, vechulhu alfin verivvan kulhu. nafke mehanne raza shinan. umehane diukenin mitparshin kol chad vechad besitrayyhu kema deitchazze lon.

Veillen innun deka meshallevan chad bechad vechalil chad bechad lemehve kol chad vechad kelilan bechavreh, shor nesher arye adam itnahagan (ba mag amud bet) beraza dearba shemahan gelifan salkin leitnahaga uleistakkala.

Salik leitnahaga uleistakkala shor leanpe adam. salik shema chad mitattera mechakka beraza ditren gevavnin veihu el. keden ithaddar laachora vechureseh chakik vegalif leh. veitreshim leitnahaga beraza dishma da.

Salik leitnahaga uleistakkala (yitro 80 amud bet, tetze refa amud bet) nesher leanpe adam. salik shema ochora mitattera mechakkeka beraza ditren anpin gevavnin leitnahara uleistalka bisliku beittura dilela veihu gadol. keden ithaddar laachora vechureseh chakik vegalif leh veitreshim leitnahaga beraza dishma da.

Salik leitnahaga uleistakkala arye leanpe adam. salik shema ochora mitattera mitchakkeka beraza ditren anpin gevavnin leittakkefa uleityashshera betukepa veihu gibbor. keden ithaddar laachora vechureseh chakik vegalif leh veitreshim leitnahaga beraza dishma da.

Adam istakkal bechulhu vechulhu salkin umistakkelin beh. keden kulhu itztayyru begilufayyhu betziura da beraza dishma chad deikre nora. ucheden ketiv alayyhu (Yechezkel 1:10) udemut penehem pene adam, kulhu kelilan behay diukena. vehay diukena kalil lon.

Veal raza da ikre kudesha berich hu (Nechemya 9:32) hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora. deha shemahan illen gelifin innun leel (leella) beraza dirticha illaa, kelila bearba atvavn Adonai deihu shema dechalil kolla. diukenin illen mechakkekan gelifan bechuresayay. vechuresayay gelifa merakma behu chad leyamina vechad lismala vechad lekamma vechad laachora reshima bearba sitrin dealma.

Kurseyay kad salka reshima bearba diukenin illen, illen arba shemahan illain natlin lehay kurseyay, vekurseyay itkelil behu ad denakta velakta nafshin veinnugin dechissufin. kevan denakta velakta innun innugin vechissufin, nachata malyay, keilana demalyay anpin lechol setar umale avin (ivin).

Kevan denachati (denachta) nafke illen arba diukenin mitztayyrin betziyyurayyhu gelifan menaharin netzitzin melahatin. veinnun zarin zara al alma, keden itkere, esev mazria zera, esev deinnun zarin zara al alma.

Nafka (kevan) diukena deadam dechalil kol diukenin. keden ketiv etz peri ose peri lemino. asher zaro vo al haaretz. la appik zara ella letoalta. al haaretz asher zaro vo dayyka. mikkan delet reshu levar nash leappaka zara minneh levattala.

Chatztzir (nusach acher deshe) (raza) dehacha lav ihu mazria zera. uvegin kach itbattal vela kayyma bekiyyuma (19 2, 41) kehane acharanin, delet le diukena leitztayyra uleitgelafa bediyyukena vetziyyura kelal. ella itchazzun vela itchazzun. kol innun dela itztayyru betziyyura vediyyukena let lon kiyyuma. kayyme lefum shaata veitachilu beesha deachla esha umihadderin kemidillekaddemin vechen bechol yoma.

(Vaychi 215) bar nash letatta it leh diukena vetziyyura, vela ihu bekiyyuma kegavvna dehane dilela. tziyyura vediyyukena dilel (dilella). mitztayyrin betziyyurehon kema dehavyayn bela malbusha ochora leitztayyra. uvegin kach innun bekiyyuma tadir. tziyyura deadam letatta mitztayyrin betziyyurayyhu bemalbusha vela kegavvna (begavvna) ochora, uvegin kach kayyeymin bekiyyuma zeman veiddan.

Uvechol lelya velelya mitpashshat rucha mehay malbusha vesalka (leella). vehahu esha deachla achil leh. uvatar ithaddar kemilkaddemin umitztayyrin bilvushayyhu. uvegin kach let lon kiyyuma keinnun diukenin dilel. veal da ketiv, (Eicha 3:23) chadashim labbekarim. bene nesha deinnun chadashim bechol yoma veyoma.
37: May tama, rabba emunatecha, rabba ihu vela zeera.

Rabba emunatecha vadday rabba deyachla lenatla kol bene alma uleachlala lon begavvav illaa vetattaa. atar rav vesagge ihu dechalil kolla velo itmalyay yattir. veraza da (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam vehayyam enennu male vegomer azle legabbe yamma veyamma natil lon veachil lon begavveh vela itmalyay. uvatar appik lon kemilkaddemin veazle. uvegin da rabba emunatecha.

Beyoma da ketiv ki tov ki tov tere zimne. begin deyoma da achid litteren sitrin veafrish machloket. amar lehay sitra ki tov ulehay sitra ki tov veaskim benayyhu. uvegin kach it beh teren zimnin vayyomer vayyomer. hacha raza dishma dearba atvavn gelifa mechakkeka salik litresar atvavn bearba diukenin bearba sitrin rashim al kuresyay kaddisha:

Vayyomer elohim yehi meorot vechulei. meorot chaser. deitbere askera leravye. devatar deitgeniz nehiru or kadmaa. itbere kelippa lemocha, vehahi kelippa itpashshat veappik kelippa ochora. kevan denafkat salka venachata matat legabbe anpe zutere, baoat leitdabbeka behu uleitztayyra begavavyyhu vela baoat leafresha minnayyhu, afrash lah kudesha berich hu mittamman venachit lah letatta, kad bera adam begin leatkana hay behay alma.

Kevan dechamat lechavva deka mitdabbeka besitroy deadam deshappiru dilela vechamat diukena shelim, parcha mittamman, uvaoat kemilkadmin leitdabbeka beanpoy zutere. innun natre tarin dilel la shavku lah. nazaf kudesha berich hu bah veattil lah beshippule yamma.

Veyatvat tamman ad dechata adam veinteteh. keden appik lah kudesha berich hu mishshippule yamma, veshalta al kol innun ravye appe zutera divne nesha deitchazun leaanasha bechove deavuhon. veihi azla meshatteta bealma. kerevat letare gan eden deara vechamat keruvim natre tare degan eden veyatva tamman legabbe hahu lahat hacherev begin dehi nafkat missitra dehahu lahat.

Beshaata dehahu lahat ithappach arkat umeshotetet bealma veishtakkechat ravye deitchazun leitanasha vechayychat behu uketelat lon. veda ihu (pikkude romach amud bet) bigriu desihara deazirat nehora veda meorot kad ityelid kayin lo yachla leitdabbeka beh. levatar itkerivat bahadeh veolidat ruchin vetisin.

Adam mea utelatin shenin shimmesh beruchin nukevin, ad deatat naama umiggo shappiru dilah tau beni haelohim batrah aza vaazael veolidat minnayyhu. uminnah itpashtu ruchin bishin veshedin bealma, deihi azlat umeshotetet belelya (nusach acher baleyleyt) veazlat bealma vechayychat (nusach acher vechayychan) bivni nesha veavde lon deoshdun keri. uvechol atar deashkechan beni nesha nayymin yechidain beveta sharan alayyhu veachidan lon umitdabbekan behu venatle minnayyhu teuveta veolidan minnayyhu. vetu (11 amud alef) pagin beh bemarin vela yada. vechol da bigriu desihara.

Meorot kad ittakkanat sihara, ithappechan atvavn (Tehillim 18:31) imrat Adonai tzerufa. magen hu lechol hachosim bo. magen hu al kol innun ruchin bishin vekastirin dimshotte bealma bigriu dilah lechol innun deachidan beh behemnuteh dekudesha berich hu.

Shelomo malka kad nachit leamka deegoza dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 6:11) el ginnat goz yaradti, natal kelippa deegoza veistakkal bechol innun kelippin veyada (nusach acher veistakkal dechol innun lo nivreu ella maaynevagea) dechol innun innugin dehanhu ruchin kelippin deegoza lav ihu ella leitdabbeka bivne nesha (nusach acher valeasetaah) uleistaav lon dichtiv, (Kohelet 2:8) vetaanugot bene adam shidda veshiddot.

Tu taanuge beni adam demitannege beshenta delelya, nafka minnayyhu shidda veshiddot. vecholla itzterich kudesha berich hu lemivre bealma uleatkana alma behu. vecholla mocha lego vechamma kelippin chafya lemocha. vechol alma kehay gavvna ela vetatta
Meresh raza dinkuda illaa ad sofa dechol dargin. kulhu
38: Ihu da levusha leda, veda leda. da mocha lego mocha ukelifa (sefer acher mocha) rucha. da lego min da. veda lego min da. ad deishtechach dehay kelippa lehay vehay lehay.

Nekuda kadmaa hava nehiru penimaa delet leh shiura leminda zechichu vedakkiku venakyu dileh. ad deitpeshat peshitu. vehahu peshitu dehahi nekuda itavid chad hechala leitlabbesha hahi nekuda nehiru dela yedia lisgiu zikkucha dilleh.

Hechala deihu levusha lehahu nekuda setima ihi nehiru delet leh shiura. veim kol da lav dakkik vezachich ihu kehahi nekuda kadmaa tamir veganiz. hahu hechala itpashshat peshitu or kadmaa. vehahu peshitu ihu levusha lehahu hechala dakkik vezachich penimaa yattir.

Mikkan ulehala itpashshat da beda veitlabbash da beda. ad deishtechach da levusha leda veda leda. da mocha veda kelippa. veaf al gav deda levusha. itavid ihu mocha ledarga ochora. vecholla kegavvna da itavid hachi letatta. ad ki betzelem da ihu bar nash behay alma mocha ukelippa rucha vegufa. vecholla ihu tikkuna dealma.

Kad havat sihara beshimsha bidvekuta chada, havat sihara binhiru. kevan deitparsha min shimsha veitpakdat al (kol) chelaha, azirat garmah, azirat nehora. veitberun kelippin al kelippin lignizu democha. vecholla tikkuna democha. veal da yehi meorot chaser (ketiv). vechol da letikkuna dealma. veda hu dichtiv lehair al haaretz:

Vayyaas elohim et shene hameorot haggedolim vayyaas ribbuya vetikkuna decholla kedka yeut. et shene hameorot haggedolim bekadmita bechibbura chada. raza da shema shelim kechada Adonai elohim af al gav dela ihu beitgalleya ella beorach satim.

Haggedolim deitberiu (nusach acher deitrabbiu) bishma da keda leitkere behu shema decholla. matzepatz matzepatz illen shemahan illain ditlesar mekilan derachame. haggedolim, illen itrabbiu vesalkin leela. begin deinnun illain meraza illaa vesalkin letoalta dealma deitkayyma behon almin. kegavvna da shene hameorot tarvavyyhu kechada seliku birvuta chada.

La ityeyshav sihara legabbe shimsha. da achsif mikkamme da. sihara amra (Shir HaShirim 1:7) echa tire. shimsha amra (sham) echa tarbitz batztzohorayim. sheraga zeera echden tzahir batztzohorayim. (sham) shallama ehye keotya echden bechissufa. keden azirat garmah lemehve resha letattay. dichtiv tzei lach beikve hatztzon. amar lah kudesha berich hu, zili veaziri garmach.

Umittamman let lah nehora bar mishshimsha. divkadmita havu yatve kechada beshikkula. levatar azirat garmah bechol innun dargin dilah, af al gav deihi resha alayyhu. deha let itteta beribbuya bar bevaalah kechada. et hammaor haggadol Adonai. veet hammaor hakkatan elohim sof kol dargin sofa demachashava. bekadmita itreshim ihu leela beatvavn dishma kaddisha, at reviaa dileh. ulevatar azirat garmah leitkere bishma deelohim.

Veim kol da salka lechol sitrin leel beat Adonai bechibbura deatvavn dishma kaddisha. levatar itpashtu dargin missitra da umissitra da. dargin deitpashtu missitra dilel (dilella) ikrun memshelet hayyom. dargin deitpashtun missitra detatta (diltatta) ikrun memshelet hallayla.

Veet hakkochavim shear chelin (chayyaylin) umashshiryayn delet lon chushebna dechulhu talyayn behahu rekia hashshamayim chay haolamim. dichtiv vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim. lehair al haaretz. da eretz illaa letatta kedugema da chay haolamim. veda lehair al haaretz da eretz tattaa kedugema dilel.

Malchuta dedavid. ittakkan beyoma da (veda hu) rigla vesamcha reviaa dechuresyay, ittakkanu atvavn veityayshru al duchetayyhu. veim kol da, ad yom shetitaa deittakkan diukena deadam tikkuna kedka yeut la ityeyshav beducheteh. ucheden ittakkan kuresyay illaa vechuresyay tattaa. vealmin kulhu ityayshvu beduchetayyhu. veatvavn kulhu ittakkenan
39: Veyoma reviaa ihu yoma mais mibbonim kema deat amer (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:6) bene immi nicharu vi. deha nehora da azirat garmah unehiru dilah. ukelippin itkenu al duchetayyhu. kol innun nehorin denaharan kulhu talyayn behay rekia hashshamayim leatkana behu kuresyay dedavid.

Illen nehorin metzayyran tziyyura diltatta leatkana tziyyura dechulhu deinnun bichlala deadam tziyyura penimaa. dechol tziyyura penimaa ikre hachi. umehacha kol tziyyura deitkelil beitpashtu da ikre adam. hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel la) adam attem. attem keruyin adam velo shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot.

Vechol rucha ikre adam. rucha distar kaddisha gufa dileh levusha (deadam) ihu. veal da ketiv, (Iyov 10:11) (yitro sof 75, veresh 76) or uvasar talbisheni vegomer bisra deadam levusha ihu. uvechol atar ketiv besar adam, adam lego. basar levusha deadam gufa dileh.

Tesirin diltatta deithattach behittucha derucha da. itztayyru minneh tziyyurin deitlabbeshan bilvusha ochora. kegon tziyyura divire dachyayn (Devarim 14:4-Adonai) shor se chesavim vese izzim ayyal utzevi veyachmur vegomer innun devayayn leitkelala bilvusha deadam hahu rucha penimaa deinnun sitrin (sefer acher tziyyurin), salik behahu shema deitkere vah gufa dileh levusha dehahu shema besar shor. shor ihu penimaa dehahu gufa. basar dileh levusha. vechen kulhu.

Kegavvna da besitra ochora mesoova, rucha deitpashshat bishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot nafka missitra dimsaavu lav ihu adam. uvegin kach la salik bishma da. shema dehahu rucha tame la salik bishma deadam velet beh chulaka. gufa dileh levusha dehahu tame basar tame yitma lego besar levusha dileh, begin kach beod deshare hahu rucha behahu gufa itkere tame. nafak rucha mehahu levusha lav ikre tame vela salik hahu levusha bishma.

Tesirin letatta deithattach behittucha derucha da. itztayyran minneh tziyyurin deitlabbeshan bilvusha ochora kegon tziyyure beire mesaave. veorayyta patach behu (Vayikra 11:29) veze lachem hattame. kegon chazir veofe uveire dehahu sitra rucha salik behahu shema gufa levusha dileh. vegufa besar chazir ikre. chazir lego bisra levusha dileh. uvegin kach illen teren sitrin mitparshan. illen itkelilu beraza deadam. veillen itkelilu beraza detame. kol zina azil lezineh veithaddar lezineh.

Nehorin illain deka menaharin naharin behahu rekia hashshamayim vechulei leitztayyra letatta tziyyurin kedka chaze. dichtiv vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim vegomer. velimshol bayyom uvallayla. shaltanu ditren nehorin da ihu shaltanu kedka chaze.

Maor gadol shaltano bimama. maor katan shaltano belelya. veraza da mehacha shaltanuta didchura bimama lemanaa (nusach acher lamelaah) veteh deitzterich uleoola beh tarpa umezona. kevan deal lelya venukeva nakit kolla let shuletanu deveta bar benukeva, deha keden shaltanu dilah (velo didchura) dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah. hi velo hu. memshelet hayyom didchura. memshelet hallayla denukeva.

(Meor gadol da hu shimsha veit beh teren asar pitchin. it beh tere asar shate. veshimmesha shallit al yoma. meor katan it beh tere asar pitchin veda sihara veshalta al lelya. velelya it beh teresar shate. veal da beyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. shimsha uterisar pitchin itavidan 13 mechilan derachame. lel sihara uterisar pitchin veitavidu 13 veitavidu shimsha vesihara chad. veyom valayla echad. hada hu dichtiv vayhi erev vayhi bakar yom echad veraza da leella).

Veet hakkochavim. kevan denukeva pekidat beta veitkenisat levaalah let shuletanu leveta ella leulemtan deishtaaran beveta leatkana kol tikkune beta. uvatar ithaddar beta leshaltanu didchura bimama kolla kedka chaze:

Vayyaas elohim et shene hameorot. da maor veda maor. begin kach innun nehorin desalke leela ikrun meore or. veinnun nehorin denachatu letatta ikrun meore esh deinnun dargin letatta veshalte kol yomoy dechol. veal da kad nafik shabbatta mevarchin al sheraga deha ityehiv lon reshu leshaltaa.
